jobs.title: Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Join our team and make a difference in people’s lives!**

We're looking for a **Program Coordinator** for the **Oakland, CA area!**

**Specifics:**

* **Official Job Title:** Program Coordinator
* **Job classification:** Non-Exempt, 20 hours per week
* **Job Location:** Oakland, CA
* **Pay rate:** $21.00/hr

**Our Philosophy**

**LifeSTEPS** is committed to build thriving communities by empowering individuals and families through supportive housing and services. The **STEP** in **LifeSTEPS** stands for “**S**kills **T**raining and **E**ducational **P**rograms” and is the heart of our mission. We believe community development is built “One STEP at a time.” Our vision is that every person served by LifeSTEPS will be empowered with the skills, resources, and support to maintain stable housing and break the cycle of poverty. Our founders believe that building affordable housing is only the first step. It is also essential to provide meaningful programs that empower people to move forward in their lives.

**About us**

LifeSTEPS, is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit charitable organization. It was founded in 1996 and currently has over 440 partnered affordable housing properties all over the state of California. We serve several regions from Sacramento, Bay Area, South Bay, Central Valley, LA County and Inland Pacific regions. We work with 115,000 residents all over the state and we’re on a mission to provide effective educational and supportive services to maximize the strengths of individuals and build resilient communities.

**Our Benefits**

In addition to meeting your passion for making a difference in the lives of those we serve, all employees will receive the following benefits:

* Competitive pay based on skill and experience
* Paid Holidays
* Paid Sick Leave
* Employee Assistance Program
* LifeSTEPS Perks Program

Benefit eligible employees working 30 hours per week or more will also receive:

* Medical, Dental Vision, and Life Insurance
* 401(k) plan
* Identity Theft Program
* Pet Insurance
* Paid Time Off

**About the Position**

The **Program Coordinator,** under the direction of the Regional Director of Social Services, is expected to design, implement, and coordinate activities and programs within assigned affordable housing complexes. This position works closely with the Director of Social Services (DSS) to provide the highest quality of service to the residents served by LifeSTEPS.

**Core Duties** **Program Coordinator**

* Empower children from low-income and underserved families to flourish by providing after-school education and resources.
* Ensure our young individuals a caring and safe place to go after school to get assistance with homework and academic enrichment.
* Encourage children to thrive and become empowered so they can develop into resilient adults.

**Education and/or Experience and/or License Certification:**

* High School Diploma or equivalent.
* Two (2) years of experience in a similar environment providing services.
* Bachelor’s degree in social work, psychology, or related field preferred.
* Valid California Driving License and reliable, insured transportation required

Are you ready to make a difference, stand behind and support individuals and families so they achieve their goals and become empowered to move forward in their lives? Apply today!!!

**Please Note**

***LifeSTEPS values the diversity of the people it hires and serves. Diversity at LifeSTEPS means fostering a workplace in which individual differences are recognized, appreciated, respected, and responded to in ways that fully develop and utilize each person's talents and strengths. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, marital status, national origin, disability, age or covered veteran status. Please provide us with notice if you will require accommodations during the interview process***

jobs.description:
**Your Role**

The Data Management team designs and delivers innovative cloud data platforms and services that enable enterprise decision-making and business outcomes. The Technical Program Manager, Principal reports to the Sr. Manager, Data Management & Integration Management and plays a critical role in defining, driving and evolving the commercialization and operationalization strategy for cloud-based data products and services. In this position, you will lead cross-functional execution across Product Management, Engineering, Architecture, Operations, Financial Management, Agile delivery teams, and business stakeholders to ensure strategic initiatives are delivered successfully and operationally ready for adoption. You will coordinate complex dependencies, manage program risks and milestones, facilitate decision-making, and provide leadership visibility into commercialization progress, readiness, and outcomes. You will also partner with Financial stakeholders to co-lead and manage the department Finance Budget, bringing financial budgeting expertise to planning, forecasting, and tracking of spend. The ideal candidate excels at navigating ambiguity, aligning diverse stakeholders, and driving large-scale initiatives from concept through operational launch within an Agile/Waterfall delivery environment.

Our leadership model is about developing great leaders at all levels and creating opportunities for our people to grow – personally, professionally, and financially. We are looking for leaders that are energized by creative and critical thinking, building and sustaining high-performing teams, getting results the right way, and fostering continuous learning.

  

**Your Work**

**In this role, you will:**

* Lead cross-functional commercialization and operationalization initiatives across Product Management, Engineering, Architecture, Operations, Financial Management, Agile delivery teams, and business stakeholders to drive successful delivery of cloud data services
* Shape and drive commercialization strategies, integrated program roadmaps, operating models, milestones, dependencies, and execution plans across multiple workstreams
* Define and evolve commercialization operating models, governance structures, and strategic roadmaps to support long-term platform growth and service adoption.
* Lead the alignment of service, operational, financial, and technical stakeholders to establish scalable commercialization models, service delivery frameworks, and long-term operating strategies
* Manage program-level risks, issues, assumptions, dependencies, and critical decisions while driving timely resolution and executive escalation when necessary
* Coordinate commercialization and operational readiness activities including service onboarding, intake processes, support model readiness, controls implementation, and organizational preparedness
* Facilitate governance forums, executive reviews, and stakeholder discussions to drive alignment, decision-making, accountability, and successful program outcomes
* Advise leadership on commercialization priorities, operating model evolution, investment tradeoffs, and strategic decisions impacting cloud data services
* Develop and deliver executive-level communications, reporting, and presentations that provide visibility into program health, risks, milestones, outcomes, and opportunities for continuous improvement
* Partner with Financial stakeholders to co-lead and manage the department Finance Budget, including budget planning, forecasting, variance tracking, and spend governance in support of program and commercialization priorities

  

**Your Knowledge and Experience**

* Generally, requires Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience.
* 7+ years of Program Management, Technical Program Management, Technology Delivery, or related experience.
* Preferred: Minimum 5 years leading large-scale cross-functional programs involving Product Management, Engineering, Operations, Architecture, and business stakeholders.
* Project Management certification (PMP, CAPM) preferred; Agile certifications (SAFe, Scrum, Agile Program Management) desired.
* Strong understanding of cloud-based technology platforms, data products, software delivery lifecycles, enterprise operational processes, and Agile/Waterfall delivery methodologies, including Agile planning practices and tools such as Jira and Confluence.
* Proven experience leading complex programs involving multiple workstreams, dependencies, stakeholders, competing priorities, and organizational change.
* Demonstrated experience driving cross-functional alignment and execution across technical, operational, financial, and business domains while influencing decisions across multiple organizations.
* Demonstrated success defining operating models, commercialization strategies, service delivery frameworks, or large-scale transformation initiatives.
* Experience managing program-level risks, dependencies, milestones, governance processes, readiness activities, and executive communications.
* Strong communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills, including the ability to translate complex technical concepts into business-focused communications and executive-level reporting.
* Demonstrated financial budgeting experience, including interacting with Financial stakeholders to co-lead and manage a departmental Finance Budget (planning, forecasting, variance analysis, and cost management).
* Experience supporting commercialization, operationalization, service delivery, platform adoption, or large-scale business transformation initiatives preferred.

jobs.title: Program Manager, People Innovation Labs
jobs.description:
People - San Francisco

**About the Team**

At OpenAI, we are building the connective tissue between our mission and our people. People Innovation Labs is a fast-moving engineering team embedded in the People organization, focused on rethinking how we find and retain the best talent and empower everyone to do their best work.

We are not a typical internal tools team. From recruiting to cultureance and growth systems, and scalable recruiting infrastructure. We operate in a highly cross-functional environment, partnering closely with HR, Recruiting, Finance, Legal, IT, Security, and executive stakeholders.

**About the Role**

We’re looking for a Program Manager to own execution, coordination, and delivery across People Innovation Labs’ most complex and cross-cutting initiatives. This role is distinct from the Product Manager role and is focused on **how** work gets done rather than **what** we build.

As a Program Manager, you will be responsible for translating product strategy into executable plans, managing dependencies across teams and systems, and ensuring that high-stakes initiatives land predictably and cleanly in a fast-growing, high-context environment. You will partner closely with Product Management, Engineering, Design, and People stakeholders to drive clarity, accountability, and momentum across the portfolio.

Because we build new products from the ground up, the work does not end when a product launches. You’ll own ongoing engagement with users, including onboarding, training, hands-on support, and creating clear ways for people to share feedback. You’ll develop a deep understanding of how our products fit into users’ day-to-day work, what is working, and where they are struggling. You’ll bring those insights back to product, design, and engineering so the team can iterate quickly toward product-market fit.

You’ll also help keep the team aligned with its broader objectives. You’ll maintain a clear view of priorities, progress, dependencies, risks, and outcomes across the portfolio and provide clear updates and recommendations to team and company leadership.

This role is ideal for someone who excels at orchestrating work across many teams, navigating ambiguity and organizational complexity, and creating the operating structure that allows product and engineering teams to move quickly without chaos.

**In this role, you will:**

* Own program execution across multiple People Innovation Labs initiatives, ensuring clear plans, milestones, owners, and timelines
* Drive cross-functional alignment across People, Recruiting, HRBPs, Finance, Legal, IT, Security, and Engineering partners
* Manage dependencies and sequencing across systems (e.g., HRIS, ATS, permissions, data pipelines, rollout infrastructure)
* Identify risks, bottlenecks, and tradeoffs early, and proactively surface and resolve them
* Establish and maintain operating cadence for key initiatives, including status updates, reviews, launch readiness, and retrospectives
* Create clear, actionable documentation such as program plans, decision logs, rollout plans, and exec updates
* Support product launches by coordinating readiness across training, comms, support, data, and operational workflows
* Own communication, enablement, change management, and rollout strategies for new products and workflows.
* Lead post-launch user engagement through onboarding, training, office hours, hands-on support, and other programs that drive adoption.
* Build trusted relationships with users and create an environment where they provide frequent, candid feedback.
* Observe how products fit into real workflows and identify points of confusion, friction, or unmet need.
* Combine user feedback, usage data, and operational signals to understand what is working and what needs to change.
* Track delivery health and operational success metrics (e.g., timelines, adoption readiness, launch quality, post-launch issues)

**You might thrive in this role if you:**

* Have 7+ years of experience as a Program Manager, Technical Program Manager, or in a similar execution-focused role
* Are exceptionally strong at turning ambiguous, multi-stakeholder work into clear plans and accountable execution
* Communicate crisply and confidently across a wide range of audiences, including senior leaders
* Enjoy operating at the intersection of product, engineering, and business operations
* Are comfortable managing complexity across multiple systems, teams, and timelines
* Know how to introduce structure and rigor without creating unnecessary process or slowing teams down
* Have experience supporting launches of operationally intensive products or platforms
* Can identify patterns across qualitative feedback, usage data, and operational signals and turn them into actionable recommendations.
* Are energized by fast-moving environments and motivated by helping teams deliver high-impact work reliably

**About OpenAI**

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core the full spectrum of humanity.

Sales / Direct Customer Success

*8000 Marina Blvd #300, Brisbane, CA 94005, Verenigde Staten*

Build and maintain relationships with multiple customers! We’ll train you on Odoo’s diverse applications, and you’ll use your business understanding to drive adoption and expand your client base.

Odoo is an open-source enterprise resource planning (ERP) platform that helps companies manage and streamline their operations through a single, integrated system. Our modular suite of business applications—covering everything from accounting and inventory to CRM and project management—works together seamlessly to support efficiency and growth.

  

***To help us provide the best candidate experience, PLEASE SUBMIT YOUR RESUME AS A PDF and limit your applications to a maximum of 3 within a 12-month period.***

***Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or assume sponsorship responsibilities for employment visas at this time.***

### **About the Job**

**Hybrid (3 days onsite, 2 days remote) – Brisbane, CA**

The Customer Success Associate ensures seamless support for a portfolio of customers by addressing inquiries, resolving requests, and fostering satisfaction with the Odoo product. This role emphasizes reactive support, efficient task management, and collaboration with internal teams to enhance the customer experience. You’ll also develop expertise in Odoo software, share resources, and contribute to process improvements, all while maintaining a solution-oriented approach in a fast-paced environment.

### **Responsibilities**

* Manage a network of partners and approximately 1,200 customer accounts, working closely with both partners and customers to drive adoption, strengthen relationships, and support long-term growth and success across the partner ecosystem.
* Act as the primary point of contact for customer inquiries, focusing on reactive support rather than proactive upselling or high-touch engagement.
* Handle a volume of administrative customer requests with speed and accuracy.
* Provide clear customer guidance to help maximize their experience of the Odoo product.
* Maintain excellent communication and customer satisfaction throughout all interactions.
* Consistently meet performance metrics related to work ethic and task resolution.
* Utilize tools and processes to manage tasks efficiently in a fast-paced environment.
* Collaborate with internal teams to escalate and resolve more complex cases as necessary.
* Develop in-depth expertise in Odoo software to provide knowledgeable and effective support.
* Distribute educational materials and resources to assist customers with self-service options.
* Actively document and share insights to improve internal workflows and enhance customer experience.

### **Must Have**

* Bachelor’s degree preferred or equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Fluency in English and Spanish (professional or native/bilingual: reading, writing, and speaking)
* Exceptional organizational skills and dependability, with the ability to manage workloads efficiently while maintaining punctuality and consistency.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills, with an adaptable, solution-oriented mindset suited to fast-paced, reactive environments.
* Basic proficiency with G-Suite applications and customer support tools, and comfort working within standardized processes in high-pressure settings.

### **Nice to Have**

* Experience in customer support, account management, or related fields.
* Interest in software products and willingness to learn ERP or SaaS solutions.
* Ability to improve efficiency in resolving repetitive tasks.

### **How does it work in Sales?**

Our Sales Department is divided into two parts: Direct & Indirect Sales.

In Direct Sales, we work in direct contact with SMEs. In Indirect Sales, we collaborate with Partners (Odoo resellers).

* Healthcare, Dental, Vision, Life Insurance, Flexible Spending Account, Health Savings Account, 401K Matching, and Commuter Benefits
* PTO (Paid-time-off), paid sick days, and paid holidays
* Employee Assistance Program: 3 X 1-hour telehealth calls with certified mental health professionals
* Evolve in a nice working atmosphere with a passionate, growing team!
* Snacks, fruit, and coffee/drinks on tap!
* Chef-prepared lunches - snacks, fruit, and coffee/drinks on tap!
* Company-sponsored events for groups of 6+ employees

jobs.title: Sales Operations Program Manager
jobs.description:
At U.S. Bank, we’re on a journey to do our best. Helping the customers and businesses we serve to make better and smarter financial decisions and enabling the communities we support to grow and succeed. We believe it takes all of us to bring our shared ambition to life, and each person is unique in their potential. A career with U.S. Bank gives you a wide, ever-growing range of opportunities to discover what makes you thrive at every stage of your career. Try new things, learn new skills and discover what you excel at—all from Day One.

**Job Description**
-------------------

The Sales Operations Program Manager leads complex, cross-functional programs that enable sales teams to operate more effectively and deliver better client outcomes. A significant focus of the role is managing client portfolio alignment and transfers across large sales organizations, while also supporting broader sales operations priorities, including process improvement, performance insights, and program governance. The role translates business needs into clear plans and requirements, brings together the right partners, drives decisions, and ensures solutions are implemented with discipline and measurable results.

**Key responsibilities**

**Client portfolio program management**

* Lead recurring client portfolio realignment in support of the organization’s business banking client segmentation strategy.
* Oversee the portfolio transfer lifecycle, from client population scoping and data sourcing through approvals, assignments, communications, execution, and post-transfer stabilization.
* Develop and manage integrated plans with clear milestones, dependencies, decision points, owners, readiness criteria, and exit criteria for each transfer phase.

TERADYNE, where experience meets innovation and driving excellence in every connection. We are fueled by creativity and diversity of thought and in our workforce. Our employees are supported to innovate and learn something new every day.
  
  
We cultivate a culture of inclusion for all employees that respects their individual strengths, views, and experiences. We believe that our differences enable us to be a better team – one that makes better decisions, drives innovation and delivers better business results.
  
  
**Opportunity Overview**

The Operations Project Manager owns business continuity plans and manufacturing transfers across geographies for the instrumentation businesses within Teradyne's Product Test Group (PTG).

The role drives programs from post-NPI build through transfer to the global contract manufacturing network, volume ramp, and the sustaining stage. It balances high-volume production in Asia with local NPI and low-volume builds, demonstrating build-to-ship execution, and serves as the operations point of contact for cross-functional program teams.

Additionally, the role leads other programs as needed, including end-of-life management and the development of required manufacturing processes and tools through successful implementation.

**Key Deliverables**
====================

* Operations milestones (CM transfer through volume ramp) delivered on schedule and to cost and quality targets.
* CM ramp plans and schedules that meet customer demand and business objectives, demonstrated through build attainment and a successful ramp and transition to the sustaining stage.
* Material and clear-to-build readiness for each build phase, in partnership with supply chain.
* Manufacturing readiness at the CM (process, test, fixtures, capacity, Capex, and documentation) in place before ramp.
* Clear, timely reporting of program status, risks, and mitigations to PTG operations and business leadership.

**Measures of Success**
=======================

Success is measured by milestone and schedule adherence; first-customer-ship and ramp dates met; CM build attainment and on-time delivery; clear-to-build status; first-pass yield and quality; product cost versus target; E&O exposure from program changes; and open-issue closure rate.

This role requires working knowledge of electronics manufacturing (PCBA/SMT, electro-mechanical box build, and test) and, preferably, RF, photonics, or high-speed I/O instrumentation. The ideal candidate leads through influence in a matrix organization, working across internal teams (R&D, NPI and test engineering, supply chain, quality, sustaining, finance, and product management) and external partners (contract manufacturers, suppliers, and logistics providers).

Progressive experience in fast-paced organizations that respond to rapidly changing demand is a must, as is hands-on experience with contract manufacturers and NPI programs.

**Responsibilities**
====================

The Operations Project Manager ensures that PTG programs and contract manufacturing partners meet schedule, on-time delivery (OTD), cost, and quality objectives. Key responsibilities include:

**Program Planning and Execution**
----------------------------------

* Build and own integrated operations schedules for each program, including CM transfer, first customer ship, and ramp.
* Run project core-team meetings and build-readiness reviews, tracking actions, dependencies, and decisions to closure.
* Manage multiple concurrent programs at different lifecycle stages, setting priorities across them.

**NPI and CM Transfer**
-----------------------

* Partner with R&D, NPI, and test engineering on manufacturability (DFM/DFT), test strategy, fixtures, and process qualification for ramp readiness.
* Lead product transfers to contract manufacturers, including documentation, training, test setup, and pilot builds.
* Coordinate engineering changes (ECOs) and revision cut-ins with minimal disruption to builds and inventory.

**Contract Manufacturer and Build Management**
----------------------------------------------

* Own day-to-day CM engagement, including forecast-to-build-to-ship oversight, build schedules, capacity, and on-time delivery, until products approach the sustaining stage.
* Monitor CM KPIs (build attainment, yield, quality, and cost) and drive corrective actions and continuous improvement.
* Resolve process, capacity, and material issues that threaten successful transfer and ramp, customer demand, and on-time delivery.

**Material, S&OP, and Cost**
----------------------------

* Provide program input to S&OP and build-plan reviews, aligning demand, supply, and capacity with supply chain and planning.
* Partner with supply chain on clear-to-build, long-lead and risk buys, and E&O exposure from program changes.
* Track product cost and operations budgets (including Capex for test equipment and fixtures) against targets.

**Risk, Reporting, and Continuous Improvement**
-----------------------------------------------

* Identify program risks early and drive mitigation and contingency plans.
* Prepare clear status, KPI, and risk repo

**Building Healthcare That Remembers**
======================================

Every time you call a doctor's office, the system forgets you the moment you hang up. You wait on hold, explain everything from scratch, get bounced between lines, and hope someone follows up. Everyone has felt this. No one should have to.

At Assort Health, we're building one continuous conversation for every patient. An AI agent that knows who you are, remembers how you like to be reached, and carries that context from your first symptom to your full recovery. What began as the first voice AI agent to schedule a specialty appointment has become the largest proprietary specialty dataset in healthcare: 345 million patient interactions, 62,000 care protocols, 1.6 million decision pathways.

We went from 15 people in 2025 and will cross 250 by the end of 2026. Revenue is up 20x in 15 months and we've raised $222 million, including a recent $120 million Series C at a $1.2 billion valuation from investors including Menlo Ventures and Lightspeed. We've also been named to the Forbes Cloud 100 and the 2026 Enterprise Tech 30 as the only healthcare AI company on the list!

Healthcare spends $1.1 trillion a year on administration instead of care. If you want to help change that, apply below.

**About the Role**
==================

We're building a suite of products that helps healthcare organizations coordinate complex workflows across the patient journey. In this role, you'll work closely with our Chief Product Officer to drive our most important product initiatives and shape strategic decisions about where we invest and how we grow. You'll also connect engineering, product, and design with our go-to-market teams, helping teams plan across products and giving marketing, sales, and customer-facing teams what they need to launch products and support customers.

**What You'll Do**
==================

* **Own product planning across teams.** Keep roadmaps current, help teams prioritize shared platform capabilities, and make it easier for leaders to shift resources as company priorities and customer needs change.
* **Coordinate launches and product updates.** Give product marketing the timing and context to shape positioning, help sales and enablement teams prepare, and equip customer-facing teams to onboard and support customers. Build a repeatable process for letting sales engineering, product marketing, and enablement know when new capabilities are ready to demo.
* **Make product information easy to find and use.** Revamp the central source of truth for product plans and updates, establish standards teams can follow, and standardize dashboards for product metrics and competitive insights.
* **Drive priority initiatives with the Chief Product Officer.** Turn decisions into clear plans, keep owners and stakeholders aligned, and surface decisions and tradeoffs early.
* **Inform product and business strategy.** Translate competitive research, customer feedback, and market analysis into recommendations on annual product priorities, pricing, monetization, and expansion. Assess specialties and care pathways and recommend which to pursue first.

**What You Bring**
==================

* Experience in consulting, business operations, strategy, or a similar role that required you to bring structure to open-ended problems.
* Strong analytical judgment and the ability to turn research and data into clear recommendations.
* A track record of moving several initiatives forward at once, with clear owners, milestones, and decisions.
* The ability to build trust and drive alignment across technical, commercial, and executive teams.
* Curiosity about how products are built, brought to market, and adopted. You ask pointed questions, test assumptions, and help teams make better decisions. We welcome candidates whose experience is outside product management.

**Nice to Have**
================

* Experience at a high-growth technology company.
* Experience working in or closely with a product or marketing team.

**Benefits & Perks for Assorties**
==================================

* **Competitive Compensation** – Including salary *and* employee stock options so you share in our success.
* **Lifelong Learning** – Annual budget for professional development, plus training opportunities to help you grow.
* **Office Setup Stipend** – We’ll outfit your in-office workspace so comfy as it's productive.
* **Top-Tier Health Coverage** – Medical, dental, and vision insurance, because your health comes first.
* **Flexible PTO** – We trust you to take the time you need to recharge and come back ready to crush it.
* **Meals & Snacks** – Lunch, dinner, and snack breaks that fuel great ideas.
* **Fitness Stipend** – Your wellness matters. We reimburse monthly membership costs to support your health.
* **Commuter Benefits** – We cover eligible transportation costs to make your trip to work easier.
* **401(k)** – Build your retirement savings.

**How We Work & What We Value**
===============================

Our team at Assort Health moves fast, stays focused, and is fueled by a desire to serve our customers and patients. Our company values guide *how* we work—they are present in how we show up, make decisions and work together to move our mission forward. We bring a **Day One Drive**, relentlessly striving to improve, keep a **5-Star Focus**, as our customers are our lifeblood, always **Answer the Call**, remembering that ownership and accountability are paramount, and show up with **One Pulse**, because we are one team, with one rhythm and one result. Our team is growing and we are looking for motivated, hardworking, and passionate talent. If you want to make healthcare accessible for everyone, we’d love to hear from you!  
  
**Please note:** the Assort Health Talent Team will only email you from an assorthealth.com email address.

The Operations Manager is primarily responsible for, but not limited to:

**Job Responsibilities:**

* Effectively manage on-time performance and driver availability.
* Effectively manage all call center functions.
* Effectively manage customer relations through both direct contact and outreach programs.
* Identify, select, train and mentor location staff.
* Effectively and frequently communicate with location staff and support team members.
* Assist in overseeing safety and training programs, plans and processes to ensure compliance with company, contract and regulatory requirements.
* Contributes to maintain the safety culture of the division.
* Maintain client contact routinely to meet or exceed expectations.
* Assist with conducting periodic departmental audits.
* Daily, weekly and monthly review of key operational metrics.
* Implement, promote and adhere to company policies and procedures.

* Experience managing fast paced environment.

jobs.title: Strategic Operations Manager, Mobility Operations
jobs.description:
**About the Role**  
  
Uber is looking for a highly motivated individual to join our US & Canada Mobility Operations team. If you love setting a vision, managing cross-functional partners, pushing projects forward to deliver strategically meaningful results, and solving problems from both 30,000 feet as well as deep in the details, this is the role for you!  
  
We're generating vast amounts of data every day. We use this data to inform everything we do: ensure balance in the marketplace, identify ways to continually make the Uber experience better for earners and riders, deploy incentives and promotions, understand customer behavior, develop and launch new product offerings, and more. Strategic Operations Managers are responsible for developing strategies, such as how we balance our marketplace, target and deploy earner promotions, manage local markets, and identify and solve operational weaknesses. They balance improving or innovating new processes with setting and delivering on goals to meet business needs.  
  
**What You’ll Do:**  

* Strategic Ownership: Help develop, lead, and implement strategy to achieve business priorities
* Business Influence: Monitor, understand, and interpret key operational and financial metrics to help figure out strategy and action plans. Develop and apply understanding of the levers that move our business
* Problem Solving: Identify the root cause of risks and opportunities, propose multiple, practical solutions, and weigh tradeoffs to recommend best approach
* Process Optimization: Implement, optimize, and scale core analyses and processes, regularly reviewing performance
* Product Improvement: Proactively search for new features or improvements that could improve the experience on and efficiency of our marketplace, measure their impact and collaborate with Product teams to implement launches
* Stakeholder Management: Maintain productive working relationships with immediate team and cross-functional partners across operations, marketing, customer support, product, policy, and legal to scope, test and implement initiatives

  
**Basic Qualifications**  

* Bachelor's degree required
* 1+ years of experience in investment banking, consulting, business intelligence, strategy  
  or related experience
* Excel proficiency (modeling, data visualization)

  
**Preferred Qualifications**  

* Working knowledge in applying SQL, Python, R, Stata or similar statistical languages and tools
* High-growth operations or startup experience is strongly preferred
* Phenomenal collaborator, and someone who proactively works across teams, able to influence senior and external stakeholders
* Storytelling through Data: Transform data analyses into an understandable storyline across tech and non-tech audiences in order to influence business decisions
* Data-Driven Mentality: Make strategic decisions based on data analysis and interpretation. Experience getting in the weeds of data, balanced with the ability to see the big picture
* Communication: Ability to interpret and present data to various audiences in an engaging and comprehensive, yet succinct manner
* Teamwork: Demonstrate optimism, respect others, and promote a team environment where individuals can communicate and contribute freely. Ability to work with people from diverse backgrounds and responsibilities. Maintains healthy working relationships, even in disagreement
* Executional Excellence: Ability to work and accomplish multiple tasks in parallel, delivering results in a fast-paced and ambiguous environment, while maintaining high-quality work standards
* Planning & Organization: Ability to create detailed project plans with project stages, milestones, basic interdependencies, and owners

  
For New York, NY-based roles: The base salary range for this role is USD$106,000 per year - USD$118,000 per year.  
  
For San Francisco, CA-based roles: The base salary range for this role is USD$106,000 per year - USD$118,000 per year.  
  
For Washington, DC-based roles: The base salary range for this role is USD$106,000 per year - USD$118,000 per year.  
  
**Ready to Ride?**  
  
This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook — it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves — we'd love to hear from you.  
  
You may be eligible for bonuses, equity, and other compensation, as well as a range of benefits. Explore our benefits.  
  
Offices remain key to collaboration and Uber's culture. Unless approved for full remote work, employees must spend at least 50% of their time in-office. Some roles, like those at greenlight hubs, require full-time in-office presence. Ask your Recruiter for details about this role's requirements.  
  
Uber is proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing this form.

jobs.description:
Location San Jose, CA

Type Direct Hire

Salary $72,000 - $120,000 / yr

ID j-1688

Posted Nov 23, 2026

Service Manager / Technical Operations Manager – Two-Way Radio & Wireless | Nationwide

**Job type:** Full-time

**Pay:** Average $80,000–$105,000 per year (potential range $72,000–$120,000+)

**Location:** Nationwide – all major U.S. cities and all 50 states

### **Job Summary**

Our client needs an experienced **Service Manager / Technical Operations Manager** to lead the technical service department for a commercial two-way radio and wireless communications business, with openings in all major U.S. cities and all 50 states. You will manage technicians, protect customer satisfaction, and keep service operations profitable and efficient.

**Focus:** technical operations leadership, field and bench technician management, warranty administration, and service dispatching.

### **What You'll Do**

* Lead, schedule, and coach a team of radio technicians and installers
* Oversee repairs, installations, programming, and preventive maintenance
* Manage service contracts, SLAs, and warranty processes
* Track KPIs including turnaround time, utilization, first-time fix, and customer satisfaction
* Manage parts inventory, vendors, and service pricing
* Collaborate with sales and engineering to support new and existing accounts

### **What You Bring**

* 4+ years in two-way radio, LMR, or wireless service, with 2+ years in a lead or management role
* Strong technical knowledge of DMR, MOTOTRBO, repeaters, and RF systems
* Experience managing technicians and service workflows
* Solid understanding of service contracts and customer expectations
* Excellent organization, communication, and problem-solving skills

### **Nice to Have**

* Experience in a dealer or commercial radio shop environment
* Familiarity with service management and dispatch software

### **Compensation & Benefits**

Average annual salary $80,000–$105,000, with a potential range of $72,000–$120,000+. Final compensation details will be discussed in connection with specific opportunities.

jobs.description:
JAS is an international, non-asset-based supply chain services and solutions company. Our services include air and ocean freight forwarding, contract logistics, customs brokerage, distribution, inbound logistics, truckload brokerage and other supply chain management services, including consulting, the coordination of purchase orders and customized management services.

The Operations Manager will be responsible for all operational services, including but not limited to Imports/Exports via Air/Ocean movement, as well as warehousing, and customs brokerage oversight. This role is responsible for supporting branch operational excellence, product initiatives, while driving operational, financial, and compliance objectives.

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:**

* Technical understanding of operational functions to ensure the branch remains compliant with JAS process and procedures as well as governmental standards.
* Meet company & customer established KPIs (Key Performance Indicators).
* Management of KPIs by utilizing the operational and financial dashboards.
* Responsible for managing operations distribution and workloads, to ensure client and contractual needs are met.

Today, Storage Squad helps students at 40+ schools across 15+ states – and we’re still growing! Our partner schools appreciate how we help students while reducing congestion in and around campus, and our students and families appreciate how we make move-in and move-out easier and less stressful.

**Seasonal | Part-Time | Hourly + Performance Bonuses**

**About the Role**

Storage Squad is looking for a **Team Operations Manager** to join our team during our busy season. This is a great opportunity for someone looking to **build leadership and operations experience, develop valuable business skills, or supplement their income with seasonal work.**

This is a hands-on role where you'll help coordinate people, schedules, vehicles, logistics, and customer services while working alongside your team to keep daily operations running smoothly.

**Previous management or logistics experience is helpful, but not required.** We're looking for someone who is dependable, organized, comfortable taking initiative, and enjoys working with people.

**What You'll Do**

* Recruit, train, schedule, and support seasonal team members.
* Coordinate daily schedules, routes, vehicle rentals, pickups, and deliveries.
* Help oversee shipping, receiving, inventory, and warehouse organization.
* Communicate with customers, university partners, vendors, and Storage Squad management.
* Address customer questions and concerns with a professional, solution-focused approach.
* Help resolve operational challenges and keep projects on schedule.
* Drive company or rental vehicles when needed.
* Assist with loading, unloading, moving, pickups, and deliveries during busy periods.
* Lead by example and help create a positive, productive team environment.

**What We're Looking For**

* Dependable, organized, and responsible.
* Strong communication and customer service skills.
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced, hands-on environment.
* Able to take initiative and solve problems as they arise.
* Comfortable working as part of a team and taking a leadership role when needed.
* Valid driver's license.
* Ability to perform physical tasks, including lifting, loading, unloading, and moving boxes and belongings.
* **Commercial driving, logistics, or management experience is a plus, but not required.**

**Why Join Storage Squad?**

This position is a great way to **gain real-world experience while earning supplemental income.** You'll have the opportunity to develop skills in:

* Team leadership
* Operations and logistics
* Recruiting and training
* Customer service
* Scheduling and route coordination
* Warehouse and inventory management

Whether you're looking to build your resume, gain management experience, or pick up seasonal income, this role offers meaningful responsibility and hands-on experience.

**Position Details**

**Job Type:** Seasonal, Part-Time  
**Season:** MONTH – MONTH, YEAR  
**Pay:** Hourly + potential performance-based bonuses  
**Schedule:** Flexible/seasonal, with increased hours during peak periods

**Interested in joining the team? Apply today!**

We are WPP Production - the unified global production company that brings together all of WPP's content producers, studios and craft experts into one connected organisation. We combine world-class human craft with next generation technology to originate, design, and deliver multi-channel content systems at scale. Built for borderless collaboration and powered by deep craft expertise, we are the production engine designed for today's always on, AI driven marketing world.

**About WPP**

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com.

**A Hybrid working model**

*We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we've adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around three days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.*

***"This is a Contract role - Duration approx. 3 months"***

The Program Manager (PM) is responsible for managing the production of all screen and hardware images that are used throughout the client's marketing deliverables. The primary focus of this position is to manage the process for the production of images, video or interactive projects by working with Creative and Production teams to plan, track and drive deadlines for new and existing images. In addition, build and foster relationships with vendors, external and inter-departmental groups throughout the client who require images. Manage production schedules for image elements within projects and provide final screens to all business partners

**Key responsibilities:**

* Manage image schedules/expectations/resource management/image tracking

* Manage project screen and hardware deliverables with localization scope in mind

* Partners with Producers and Production teams to develop tools and systems for process and streamlined workflows
* Schedule and facilitate pre and post production meetings with the Image Production team
* Keep current with emerging technologies while constantly evolving the process for efficiencies
* Develop briefing materials for current workflows and collaborate to develop and implement a new dissemination method.

**Requirements**

* Ability to organize information quickly, at high and detailed levels
* Solid understanding and command of project management tools
* Flexibility in accommodating rapid change and capacity to learn quickly
* Proven effectiveness when working under pressure
* Facility for communicating effectively from one-on-one to large groups

* Appreciation for the creative process and skilled at working with creative and production teams
* Experience tracking and prepping deliverables for localization
* Ability to make sound decisions, think strategically, focus on detail, problem solve, multi-task, and have an excellent memory
* Must possess exceptional organization, time management, excellent verbal/written communication skills, interpersonal skills and ability to prioritize
* Proficiency to work in a fast paced, demanding, creative and production environment, solution-oriented and experience of Photoshop. Flexibility is key to this role.
* Requires a minimum of a bachelor's degree in a related field and 5+ years working ad
* Solid understanding of print formats; resolution, color space, and other technical requirements of assets needed for image reproduction
* Good working knowledge of Photoshop.

Individual compensation varies based on job-related factors, including location, business needs, level of responsibility, experience, and qualifications. jobs.title: Energy Storage Project Manager (Lost Hills, CA)
jobs.description:
***SOLV Energy is a leading provider of infrastructure services to the power industry, designing, building and maintaining utility scale solar, battery storage and high voltage substation projects nationwide.***

**Job Description Summary:**

The Energy Storage Project Manager will provide leadership and oversight to an individual project. They will collaborate with multiple departments in planning, organizing, and directing the project work across our team, including engineering, scheduling, change management, budgeting, and closeout project documentation.  
  
This role is located full-time on a jobsite in Lost Hills, CA and will require travel. Specific location details and expectations will be discussed during the interview process.

**Job Description:**

* *This job description reflects management's assignment of essential functions; it does not prescribe or restrict the tasks that may be assigned*

**Position Responsibilities and Duties:**

* Work with the project execution team to understand multiple work disciplines along with being a leader in scheduling, cost control, quantity tracking, procurement, client satisfaction, daily jobsite needs, and work activities
* Develop and maintain good relationship with Owner, Engineer, and Subcontractors; develop strategies and skills to build a strong partnership with the Owner, while still ensuring prompt owner notification of impacts and preservation of rights per the Prime Contract
* Maintain timely and accurate reporting to management, particularly with regard to cost forecasting and estimated cost at completion.
* Oversee preparation of project billings; seek to maximize cash flow in and reduce pay cycles through diligent & strategic billing preparation. Prioritize the collection of aged receivables and review their status regularly in Owner meetings and conversations.
* Present and negotiate change orders with owner for timely resolution.
* Coordinate, lead, and document routine project update meetings with client and internal stakeholders regarding the status and progress of the work
* Coordinate with the project team to identify needs, develop scopes of work, and hire appropriate third parties to execute the work
* Extensive coordination with material suppliers to ensure timely deliveries and to develop solutions to logistical and supply-chain challenges.
* Review contract conditions; ensure compliance with all contract terms
* Supervise documentation of all significant project events, e.g., accidents, delays, Change Orders
* Effectively manage project risk; evaluate probability and severity of risk events as they are identified / anticipated and prepare mitigation plans with project team and senior management
* Ensure jobsite office networking services are set-up (copiers/printers/scanners, phone lines, etc.)
* Enforce and promote a culture of safety by implementing and enforcing SOLV standards and OSHA policies, procedures and guidelines
* Assist the site management team in displaying and promoting the company values, tenets and culture while representing the company in a professional manner

**Objectives or Goals to Measure Performance:**

* Project profitability
* Project completed on schedule
* Customer/Client Satisfaction
* Positive project team attitude
* Adherence to Company policies and Corporate Procedures and Electrical Safety Manual
* Work within SE’s business processes and ensure an efficient working environment
* Improved personal professional growth and education
* Staff development and training

**Minimum Skills or Experience Requirements**

* Minimum 5 years of work-related experience in design and/or construction of utility scale electrical infrastructure projects.
* Direct relevant industry experience preferred, skilled with knowledge related to the construction and operation of the electrical equipment and installation
* Leadership ability – able to pull together team members from diverse backgrounds in a remote environment and organize them into a cohesive, high-performing project team.
* Able to travel extensively (potentially more than 50%) including lengthy jobsite-based assignments.
* Excellent customer service and interpersonal skills to work with others under all situations
* Ability to work, analyze, troubleshoot and prioritize problems independently
* Effective written and verbal English communication skills
* Proficiency and knowledgeable in office practices, procedures and equipment
* Strong organizational skills with ability to prioritize and coordinate
* P6 scheduling experience preferred

**Physical Demands and Environmental Conditions:**

* Requires frequent stooping, bending, crouching, reaching, handling, sitting, standing, walking, and lifting 50 or more lbs
* Constant finger dexterity and ability to see details at close range and at a distance, hear, talk, and possess depth perception
* Occasional climbing and carrying, proximity to moving mechanical parts, working in high exposed places
Occasional exposure to environmental conditions  

  

*Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the U.S. without requiring employer sponsorship now or in the future.*

jobs.description:
Summary
  
  
Apple's sustainability commitments matter to our customers, our communities and the planet, and the regulations that support them are growing fast. We are building a new Sustainability Regulatory Reporting group to meet them. As a Senior Project Manager, you will help shape the group from day one. This high-visibility role brings many teams together around one goal: delivering Apple's regulatory obligations. Because the group is new, the role carries real influence over how we work, including building repeatable, scalable processes that last well beyond the first reporting cycle and setting the standard for a new team.
  
  
Description
  
  
This role leads end-to-end delivery of Apple's EU sustainability regulatory agenda: the Corporate Sustainability Reporting Directive (CSRD), EU Taxonomy (EUT) and Corporate Sustainability Due Diligence Directive (CSDDD). It also manages the wider portfolio of recurring sustainability reporting obligations, such as Australian climate-related financial disclosures. The work spans complex data, supply chain and multiple jurisdictions, and the goal is to meet regulatory deadlines with high-quality data, defensible governance and clean assurance outcomes.
  
  
Minimum Qualifications  
  
  

* 7+ years of project/program management experience, including at least 3 years managing regulatory, sustainability or compliance transformation programs.
* Bachelor's degree required; advanced degree in sustainability, law, business or related field is a plus.

  
  
  
Preferred Qualifications  
  
  

* Experience managing cross-functional programs spanning multiple departments in a complex global organization with multi-tier supply chains.
* PMP, PRINCE2, Agile/Scrum certification or equivalent.
* Knowledge of EU Taxonomy, CSRD, ESRS and CSDDD; exposure to other jurisdictions' non-financial reporting regimes.
* Strong stakeholder management skills, including experience presenting to senior leadership.
* Demonstrated strong organization skills to manage overlapping regulatory calendars and deadlines.

  
  
  
At Apple, base pay is one part of our total compensation package and is determined within a range. This provides the opportunity to progress as you grow and develop within a role. Apple employees are eligible for discretionary restricted stock unit awards, and can purchase Apple stock at a discount if voluntarily participating in Apple’s Employee Stock Purchase Plan. **DESCRIPTION**

Kalman Varga Design (KVD) is looking to bring on a new team member to grow our boutique residential landscape architecture firm. We are based in Noe Valley San Francisco, CA with semi-remote workers in the Bay Area. We are looking for highly motivated individuals who strive to create unique landscapes for residences ranging from urban pocket gardens to wine country estates. Our boutique firm relies on team members to wear many hats; from schematic sketching to construction detailing and coordination with city officials, contractors and clients. The principle, Kalman Varga, comes from an architectural background and takes pride in the detail and precision of the firm's drawings and architecturally oriented designs.

**THE POSITION**

Designer + Project Manager with a minimum of five years of professional experience in landscape architecture or architecture. This position is ideal for a well-rounded individual who can confidently take projects from conceptual design through construction documentation and implementation. The successful candidate will work closely with the principal while independently managing assigned projects, coordinating with consultants and contractors, and providing guidance and oversight to a junior designer. KVD is looking for someone who combines a strong design sensibility with practical construction knowledge and excellent organizational skills.

**PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Site inventory, which may include hand measured plans for smaller urban projects.
* Collaboration in developing schematic concepts and feature design.
* Drafting and redlining of presentation, permit, pricing and construction drawings in Vectorworks.
* 3D modeling in SketchUp.
* Assisting junior design staff in furthering their construction detailing abilities.
* Partake in client presentations and site meetings and may be asked to lead these at times pending experience.
* Coordinate project detailing and logistics with contractors.
* Contractor, municipal, nursery, and sales coordination across numerous projects.
* Strategic project planning and scheduling.
* Onsite mock up review and plant layout.
* Procurement of plantings, furnishings, light fixtures and specialty features.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor’s degree in architecture or landscape architecture from an accredited program.
* 5+ years of work experience in landscape or architecture. 2 years of project management experience.
* Authorized to work in the United States.
* Valid driver’s license, car, and ability to visit sites. The ideal candidate lives in the SF Bay Area. While the office is remote; the candidate will be asked to work in person twice a week in San Francisco.
* Must be able to manage multiple projects, budgets, orders and schedules simultaneously.
* Demonstrated experience producing complete landscape construction documents. KVD drafts and renders plans in Vectorworks. Vectorworks experience is not a requirement, but an interest in learning new software in the ever evolving technology market is a must.
* Experience coordinating with architects, engineers, and contractors.
* 3D modeling experience, preferably SketchUp. Rendering experience is plus, KVD is open to team members recommendation on rendering software, we currently Photoshop and use ChatGBT over SketchUp.
* Strong design and graphic sense with the ability to verbally and graphically communicate design ideas.
* Strong work discipline, with self-management skills. Initiative and problem solving are a must.
* A people person. KVD prides itself on being a boutique firm offering the highest level of customer service to our clients.
* KVD operates on Macintosh computers but the candidate may opt to use a PC or Mac.

**WORK ENVIRONMENT**

The position is full time at 40 hours per week. Kalman Varga Design offers a flexible hybrid work environment, with two days per week working collaboratively in our Noe Valley home office and the remaining days working remotely, with site visits and project meetings as needed. As a small studio, KVD offers the opportunity to work directly with the principal, contribute meaningfully to the design process, and take ownership of projects from early design through completion. jobs.title: Program Manager
jobs.description:
**Job Summary**
---------------

Technical Program Manager

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Platform Architecture & Core Runtime: Architect, design, and lead the technical delivery of high-throughput, low-latency enterprise API gateway platforms and distributed backend services utilizing Java (JDK 17/21) ecosystems, ensuring robust traffic routing and policy enforcement.
* Distributed Data Strategy & Persistence: Define data architecture standards, caching strategies, and seamless schema migration frameworks across high-availability NoSQL and relational datastores (Apache Cassandra, PostgreSQL, ZooKeeper).
* Enterprise Delivery & Lifecycle Automation: Drive technical strategy for zero-downtime deployment automation, lifecycle orchestration, and installer tooling (Bash, Python, Linux packaging) across complex, multi-node enterprise environments.
* AppSec & Software Supply Chain Governance: Establish application security standards, lead vulnerability triage, and oversee third-party dependency/CVE mitigation frameworks across product release cycles.
* PKI, Trust & Cryptographic Architecture: Oversee enterprise-wide mTLS/TLS baselines, automated X.509 certificate governance, and compliance with FIPS-validated cryptographic standards across hybrid infrastructure fleets.
* Identity & Access Governance Architecture: Design and enforce enterprise authentication and federated identity architectures (OAuth2, OIDC, SAML, LDAP, fine-grained RBAC, and cloud IAM integration).
* Release Engineering & Delivery Pipelines: Direct end-to-end CI/CD strategy, multi-environment delivery pipelines, artifact governance, and software distribution channels for enterprise distribution.
* Cloud Infrastructure & Security Posture: Lead multi-cloud infrastructure strategy across AWS and GCP, prioritizing fleet hardening, network/firewall topology, load balancing architecture, and centralized key management (KMS).
* Technical Governance & Executive Escalations: Serve as the lead architectural escalation point for critical enterprise incidents, drive post-incident governance, and sponsor technical documentation, platform blueprints, and customer release roadmaps.

**Skill Requirements**
----------------------

* Programming & Scripting:

  + Strong production experience in Java (concurrency, networking, JVM/GC tuning, Maven/Gradle, JUnit, and multi-JDK runtime compatibility across JDK 8/17/21).
  + Advanced Bash / Shell scripting and Python 3 for Linux systems automation and CLI tooling.
* Distributed Databases & Messaging:

  + Hands-on experience operating and integrating with Apache Cassandra (CQL, driver tuning, JMX, cluster topologies) and PostgreSQL (streaming replication, major-version upgrades).
  + Working proficiency with distributed coordination and messaging systems (Apache ZooKeeper, OpenLDAP, AMQP/Qpid or similar brokers).
* Linux Systems, Networking & Web Proxies:

  + Deep knowledge of Enterprise Linux (RHEL, Rocky Linux, Oracle Linux, or Amazon Linux), systemd, Linux networking/firewalls (iptables), and RPM/Yum package management.
  + Experience configuring and troubleshooting NGINX or similar HTTP/HTTPS reverse proxies and load balancers.
* Security, Cryptography & Identity:

  + Practical experience fixing OWASP / CWE code vulnerabilities, performing CVE reachability analysis, and maintaining FIPS compliance.
  + Strong understanding of PKI, TLS/mTLS, X.509 certificates, KMS, and identity protocols (OIDC, SAML, LDAP).
* Cloud, CI/CD & Operational Excellence:

  + Hands-on experience with Git, CI/CD build pipelines, Docker, and cloud platforms (GCP and/or AWS).
  + Proven ability to debug complex, multi-node distributed systems in production and write clear technical documentation and operational runbooks.
* Leadership & Background:

  + 8+ years of progressive leadership in software architecture, technical delivery ownership, or platform engineering for large-scale distributed systems or enterprise software platforms (B.S./M.S. in Computer Science or related field).

-------------------

Java

jobs.description:
### **The Position**

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche!

**The Opportunity**
===================

The PDQ Quality Lead supports the Roche/Genentech Organization through the development and delivery of Quality strategies, audits and conclusions for entities (e.g. molecules in development, post approval products, affiliates, processes) based on a risk-based approach. Quality strategies are based on the Critical to Quality framework which encompass Good Clinical Practice (GCP), Good Pharmacovigilance Practice (GVP), In-Vitro Diagnostic / Medical Device Regulations) and Computer Systems (CS) requirements.

The Quality Lead will generate Quality strategies, evidence and actionable data through the conduct of audits and other quality activities to assess the Quality status and be able to support the demonstration of effective implementation of Quality Assurance to stakeholders and Health Authorities.

  
  

The **Senior Quality Lead** is a highly experienced Quality Professional who:

* Designs and delivers Quality Strategies and conclusions for assigned Affiliate/Product/Processes across multiple GCP/GVP/Medical Device areas. **Note: This role specifically focuses on CSV in the Pharmacovigilance space and requires CS and PV experience.**
* Contribute to the execution and delivery of PDQ work and the development of PDQ processes.
* Lead and participate in PDQ goals and initiatives and support regulatory authority inspections.
* Apply a risk-based approach to Quality Assurance strategies based on the Critical to Quality (CtQ) framework.
* Mentor and support the development of Quality Leads within the team.
  

  

**Responsibilities and Accountabilities:**

* **Design and Implement QA Strategies:** Establish strong partnerships with business stakeholders and independently define the Quality Assurance approach, assessing specific risk areas and proposing strategy modifications.
* **Define and Lead Audits:** Define the audits required to deliver the Quality Assurance strategy and lead the development of methodology, including the use of data analytics. Independently perform and lead audits, managing preparation, conduct, presentation, timely reporting of outcomes, and evaluation of actions taken.
* **Issue Management:** Independently manage 'for cause,' critical, and/or complex quality issues, group individual findings into systematic issues for process improvement, and escalate significant issues to PDQ management.
* **Quality Conclusion and Stakeholder Communication:** Independently draw conclusions on the Quality Positions and ensure appropriate action plans are developed to determine acceptability of evidence of compliance. Lead the presentation of observations and associated compliance risks to business stakeholders and Pharma representatives, including discussions with Legal and Regulatory Affairs.
* **Health Authority Inspections:** Lead inspection preparation and management of Health Authority inspections, including providing inspection training to staff and presenting Quality Strategies and conclusions.
* **PDQ Leadership:** Contribute to the long-term strategic direction of PDQ, lead departmental or cross-functional compliance projects, and lead the development/revision of PDQ processes and procedures (SOPs, Work Instructions).
* **Expertise and Mentorship:** Maintain expert knowledge of **GVP and CS regulations,** company policies, and SOPs, assess the impact of new regulations, and act as a trainer and mentor for International and Senior Quality Leads.
* **Networking:** Maintain and influence partnerships with senior business stakeholders and PDQ domains. Facilitate cross-functional collaboration to ensure quality standards are met globally.
  

  
  

**Who you are**
===============

  
  

**Qualification, Knowledge and Experience:**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in a scientific or quality-related field or equivalent combination of education, training, and experience. Advanced degree in referenced fields preferred.
* Significant experience in the pharmaceutical / biotech / medical device industry, including knowledge of the end to end development and operationalisation of products, and the associated GxP regulations. **This role specifically requires CSV and Pharmacovigilance knowledge.**

* In-depth knowledge of drug development processes and global regulatory landscapes.

* Experience influencing and driving external medical device policy change (e.g., ISO working groups, industry forums)

* Proven record of working in a global, multicultural matrixed organization (multilingual skills desirable)

jobs.title: Business Intelligence and Reporting Program Manager, Places
jobs.description:
Summary
  
  
In Places, we don’t sit back and let things happen, we make things happen, and we do this in service to all Apple employees and customers. Our team is a diverse and nimble group that manages Apple’s retail stores, workplaces, and workplace services. We develop and manage Apple’s global real estate portfolio, lead all related capital construction projects, provide outstanding facilities and site services, develop and lead sustainability initiatives to reduce the environmental impact of all Apple facilities, including commute and renewable energy programs, and do everything we can to ensure the health and safety of all Apple personnel, facilities, and customers in our facilities around the world. Within Places, our PMO brings discipline, foresight, and accountability to how we plan, fund, and deliver capital and operational programs across our global portfolio. The Program Operations team sets the standards, controls, and reporting that keep the PMO running cleanly, so leaders, partners, and business unit owners work from one shared view of what is planned, what is on track, and what needs attention. We are seeking an experienced, collaborative, and detail-driven Business Intelligence and Reporting leader to join our team as a Business Intelligence and Reporting Program Manager, to raise the bar on how Places reports on itself and bring one trusted, well-governed view of our business information to the table.
  
  
Description
  
  
As a Business Intelligence and Reporting Program Manager, you will own the reporting and data governance programs that give Places PMO one consistent, trusted view of how the business is performing, and coordinate a focused vendor management office scope for selected Workplace vendors. You will set the standards for how reports are built, define approved sources and data definitions, and make sure every material number can be traced back to logic that is documented, reviewed, and signed off. You will work closely with Program Controls, Construction, Facilities, Real Estate, Space Planning, Finance, and the business owners who run our Workplace vendor relationships to lift reporting across the PMO, while routing sourcing strategy, negotiations, and commercial terms back to the authorized teams.
  
  
Minimum Qualifications  
  
  

* 8+ years of experience leading reporting, business intelligence, data governance, operations, vendor management, or related programs, ideally within facilities, real estate, construction, or a comparable large-scale operational environment.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Management, Finance, Engineering, or a related field.
* Demonstrated experience working across multiple business functions and translating competing requests into one coherent reporting approach.
* Strong program management, analytical, and communication skills, with the ability to make complex data understandable to senior leaders.

  
  
  
Preferred Qualifications  
  
  

* Proven experience setting enterprise data definitions, source-of-truth decisions, and reporting standards across functional teams.
* Hands-on experience partnering with controls or PMO functions on KPI and SLA design, thresholds, and performance reporting.
* Experience coordinating vendor performance programs, including issue tracking, review cadences, and renewal visibility, within a defined scope boundary alongside Sourcing, Finance, and Legal.
* Experience with modern BI tools and data platforms, and with building reporting that scales across a global portfolio.
* Demonstrated ability to document, version, and change-manage report logic in a way that stands up to audit.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills, with experience presenting to executive audiences.
* Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment, with the ability to pivot priorities without losing momentum or partner trust.
* MBA or equivalent advanced degree.

  
  
  
At Apple, base pay is one part of our total compensation package and is determined within a range. This provides the opportunity to progress as you grow and develop within a role. The base pay range for this role is between $140,700 and $211,400, and your base pay will depend on your skills, qualifications, experience, and location.  
  
Apple employees also have the opportunity to become an Apple shareholder through participation in Apple’s discretionary employee stock programs. Apple employees are eligible for discretionary restricted stock unit awards, and can purchase Apple stock at a discount if voluntarily participating in Apple’s Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You’ll also receive benefits including: Comprehensive medical and dental coverage, retirement benefits, a range of discounted products and free services, and for formal education related to advancing your career at Apple, reimbursement for certain educational expenses — including tuition. Additionally, this role might be eligible for discretionary bonuses or commission payments as well as relocation. Learn more about Apple Benefits  
  
Note: Apple benefit, compensation and employee stock programs are subject to eligibility requirements and other terms of the applicable plan or program.
