jobs.title: Customer Success Manager (Investor Experience)
jobs.description:
**About Frec**
--------------

Frec is building the modern investment platform for high-net-worth investors. We combine self-directed investing with continuously managed strategies in a single brokerage account, bringing capabilities traditionally delivered through wealth managers directly to our customers.

We see AI as a way to make sophisticated investing more personal and intuitive. The investment infrastructure we’ve already built gives us a foundation to help customers make better decisions without giving up control of their financial lives.

Customers have entrusted us with $1.5 billion in assets, up 4x in the last year. We’re backed by Greylock and have reached this scale with a small team. The people who join now will help build the primary investment platform for a new generation of investors.

**The role**
------------

As an early member of Frec's Investor Experience team, you'll play a critical role in building lasting customer relationships and shaping how we serve investors as we scale.

You'll own the post-onboarding customer relationship, acting as a knowledgeable and trusted point of contact for investors with increasingly sophisticated financial needs. Your goal is to ensure customers understand the value of Frec’s investment strategies, feel confident using our platform, and have an exceptional experience throughout their relationship with Frec.

This role requires investment fluency, analytical thinking, strong relationship management skills, and the ability to make complex financial concepts accessible. You'll help customers understand everything from direct indexing and tax-loss harvesting to long short strategies, portfolio leverage, financing costs, and investment performance.

Beyond working directly with customers, you'll help build the systems, processes, and standards that define how Frec delivers an exceptional investor experience at scale.

**What you'll do**

* Own the post-onboarding customer relationship, building trust and driving long-term engagement, satisfaction, and retention.
* Help investors understand their portfolios, investment strategies, performance, tax-loss harvesting, fees, and financing costs.
* Investigate complex customer issues, taking ownership from initial discovery through resolution.
* Partner with product, engineering, and brokerage operations to identify root causes, prioritize improvements, and resolve issues.
* Identify early signs of customer dissatisfaction or disengagement and develop strategies to address them.

* Own and improve key customer experience metrics, including NPS, CSAT, customer health, retention, and response times.
* Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency through automation, AI, and better processes.
* Collect and synthesize customer feedback to influence product development and business priorities.
* Partner with sales and marketing to create a seamless experience across the entire customer journey.

**What you bring**
------------------

* 4+ years of experience in wealth management, brokerage, fintech, customer success, or a related client-facing financial services role.
* SIE, Series 7, and either Series 65 or Series 66 credentials in good standing.
* Strong understanding of financial markets, investment products, brokerage accounts, margin, leverage, and financing costs.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to build credibility with sophisticated investors.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, intellectual curiosity, and meticulous attention to detail.
* Experience working with CRM and customer engagement platforms, such as HubSpot.
* A proactive, ownership-oriented approach. You're comfortable navigating ambiguity, investigating problems independently, and building processes where they don't yet exist.
* A bachelor's degree or equivalent relevant professional experience.

**What we offer**
-----------------

* Competitive base salary with performance-based bonus opportunities
* Meaningful equity ownership in a fast-growing company
* Fully covered health and dental insurance
* 401(k) retirement plan
* Monthly wellness stipend to support physical and mental health
* Flexible paid time off
* Daily in office lunch
* The opportunity to build and shape a core function at an early-stage fintech company

Startup experience as well as familiarity with direct index and tax loss harvesting concepts is a plus! If you’ve worked in a fast-paced, high-growth environment, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement listed.

Must be able to work on-site 4 days/week from either NYC or SF

Compensation Range: $130K - $170K

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
Reactor is building the inference platform for real-time world models. Our goal is to democratize access to real-time intelligence to unlock next-generation use cases in media, physical AI and omni-directional models. We already run the largest and fastest catalog of world models on the market, and work closely with all major model labs to run and optimize their world models, including Alibaba, Amazon, and NVIDIA. Our team is made of alumni from leading firms such as Apple, Meta, Amazon, Microsoft, Luma AI, Adobe, Stability AI, and more. We've raised $74M led by Lightspeed, with Amplify Partners, WNDR, NVIDIA, Sapphire, and other Tier 1 investors participating. Jeffrey Katzenberg, co-founder of DreamWorks Animation, sits on our board of directors.

We're signing customers faster than we can look after them. You'll be our first Customer Success Manager, the person every signed customer talks to each week once the contract is done.  
  
You'll keep those customers happy, find where they can grow with us, and bring what they tell you straight back to product. A lot of what we build next will start with your notes.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Run weekly check-ins with every signed customer. Know what they're shipping, what's blocking them, and what they'll need from us next quarter.
* Get new customers live fast. Work with our forward deployed and inference engineers to take a customer from signed contract to production traffic.
* Keep a success plan for every account and run QBRs with customer leadership. Visit customers on-site to see how they're actually using Reactor.
* Spot renewals and expansions early. Find the next model, the next product line, or the next team that should be on Reactor, and close it with BD.
* Forecast each account's usage and build the ROI case behind it, so renewals and bigger commits are easy yeses.
* Treat it as a two-way relationship. Ask customers for case studies, references and early access to what they're building.
* Be the escalation point when something breaks. Pull in the right engineers, keep the customer posted, and stay on it until it's fixed.
* Watch usage and account health, and flag churn risk before it shows up in the numbers.
* Bring the customer into the building. Turn what you hear into clear, prioritized asks for product and engineering.
* Build our CS function from scratch: onboarding, health tracking, QBRs, playbooks, and the tooling behind them.

**Who You Are**
---------------

* 5+ years in customer success or account management at a technical B2B company (AI, infra, robotics, or developer tools is ideal).
* You've managed a book of high-value accounts and grown it. You can point to the expansions you drove.
* Technical enough to follow an API integration and talk latency and throughput with an engineer, then explain it plainly to a customer's exec.
* You can get engineering, product and sales moving on a customer problem without having authority over any of them.
* Organized to a fault. Every commitment from a call lands somewhere and gets done.
* You write clearly and follow up without being asked.
* You use AI tools every day and automate your own work with them.
* Happy to travel to customer sites when it helps.
* You like being early. There's no playbook yet, and you'd rather write it than wait for one.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with generative video, gaming, robotics, or foundation model customers
* Background in technical account management, solutions engineering, or consulting before CS
* You were an early CS hire somewhere and built the function
* Comfort with usage data (SQL, dashboards) to track account health
* Hands-on with a CRM (HubSpot, Salesforce, Attio)

**Benefits**
------------

* Competitive SF salary and meaningful equity in an early-stage company backed by top investors
* Direct access to founders and influence over product direction
* Visa sponsorship and relocation support
* Generous health, dental, and vision coverage

jobs.title: Partner and Services Operations Lead
jobs.description:
**About Us**
============

At LangChain, our mission is to enable every company to own its intelligence. We believe agents will transform how companies operate, and we're building the foundation to make that future possible. Our open-source harnesses and LangSmith platform give developers and enterprises the infrastructure to run, improve, and govern agents at scale.

We've raised $460M to date, with our most recent funding round valuing the company at $3B, backed by leading investors including Sequoia, Benchmark, IVP, and CapitalG. As we continue to expand our platform and tackle some of the hardest challenges in agent engineering, every team member has the opportunity to make a meaningful impact and help shape both our technology and the future of the industry.

More than 7,000 organizations rely on LangSmith, from fast-growing startups to Fortune 500 enterprises, including NVIDIA, Bridgewater, LinkedIn, Workday, and Rippling. We're just getting started on making high-performing agents easier to build and manage at scale.

**About the Role**
==================

We’re looking for a Partner and Services Operations Lead (in San Francisco or New York City) to build the operating backbone for LangChain’s growing partner ecosystem and services organization. You’ll help partner managers and services leaders turn their priorities into reliable workflows, useful data, and measurable outcomes—without adding unnecessary process.

Our partners help customers build, deploy, and get value from LangChain. Our services work spans engagements delivered by LangChain teams, external partners, and both together. As these motions grow, we need clear support paths and a consistent way to track engagements from opportunity and scope through delivery, billing, and cash collection.

You’ll partner with Partnerships, Professional Services, Customer Engineering, Deployed Engineering, Sales, Revenue Operations, Finance, Legal, and GTM Systems. Partner and services leaders will continue to own their relationships, program policies, and delivery decisions; you’ll own the operational systems, processes, and data that make those decisions work at scale.

This is a hands-on role for someone who can move between strategy and execution: helping a partner manager resolve a difficult issue, building a services scorecard, tracing a completed milestone through billing, and improving the systems behind all three.

**What You’ll Do**
==================

### **Build the partner operating model**

* Partner with partner managers to make partner onboarding, program participation, opportunity registration, co-selling, and ongoing support easier to run and inspect.
* Translate partner program policies into practical workflows, service levels, clear ownership, knowledge resources, and escalation paths. Identify recurring friction and work with program and systems owners to resolve its root cause.
* Build reliable reporting for partner activity and performance, including partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline, using agreed definitions and clear data-quality standards.
* Coordinate partner-facing resources, communications, and operational handoffs so managers and partners know where to go and what to expect as programs change.

### **Run and scale partner support**

* Own the partner support operating model: intake, routing, severity definitions, service levels, escalation criteria, case ownership, and handoffs to teams with the right expertise.
* Stay close to partner issues and escalations, especially sensitive or high-impact cases. Review misrouted requests and recurring issues, and improve the underlying rules and knowledge—not just the individual case.
* Lead and coach partner support resources and plan coverage as demand grows. Where outsourced support is used, manage vendor performance through onboarding, training, quality reviews, calibration, operating reviews, and corrective action.
* Maintain a consistent knowledge layer across partner-facing guidance, support responses, and AI-assisted content. Keep it current as policies and programs change.
* Use support and outcome data to identify opportunities for self-service and automation, with human review where a wrong answer or action carries risk.

jobs.title: Account Manager (SF)
jobs.description:
**Why Join Ivo?**
=================

Contracts are the oldest business technology in human history. They allow us to collaborate: they define what we promise each other, how we work together, and what happens when things go wrong.
  
  
Ivo builds AI products that helps companies like Meta, Uber, IBM, Intel, DoorDash, Mitsubishi Electric, and Coinbase solve their most difficult contracting problems. We think that large language models have created an opportunity to fundamentally change how businesses collaborate with each other.  
  
At Ivo you will work on challenging problems with colleagues who have high standards for each other, move fast, and care deeply about their craft.

**The Opportunity**
===================

Contracts shape how companies win customers, buy technology, work with partners, and manage risk. But reviewing them and finding the answers inside still takes too much expert time—slowing decisions across the business. Ivo is building AI that helps legal teams review and negotiate contracts, apply company standards, and turn agreements into actionable intelligence. Our ambition is bigger than making legal work faster: we're building toward becoming the system of record for how companies work with contracts.

As an Account Manager, you'll own renewals and expansion across a book of Ivo customers, and help them transform how their business works with contracts. We're hiring Account Managers across three segments: **Scaled**, **Mid-Market** and **Enterprise**. The core of the role is the same in every segment. What changes is the number of accounts you manage, the complexity of the buying process, and the seniority of the people you work with.

An account's size today is not the ceiling on what it can become. You'll build relationships beyond the original buyer, find teams whose work depends on contracts, and grow adoption of Ivo's expanding product portfolio—connecting each solution to a real business need. With ARR up sixfold in the last 12 months, there's strong momentum and a playbook still to shape.

**What You'll Own**
-------------------

* **Own the commercial health of your book.** Take responsibility for renewals and expansion, with a clear view of each customer's goals, commercial commitments, and growth potential. Decide where to spend your time based on customer need, risk, and opportunity, and move your accounts forward without waiting for a playbook.
* **Create expansion opportunities—not just respond to them.** Look beyond the original buyer and use case. Find teams whose work depends on contracts, understand their problems, and connect the right Ivo product to a real business need. Think beyond today's contract while grounding every proposal in what the customer can use and achieve.
* **Build relationships that create value across the organization.** Earn trust with day-to-day legal users, champions, business leaders, and budget owners. Understand what each stakeholder is trying to achieve, where their priorities intersect, and where they differ. You're not collecting contacts: you're building a network of people who see a meaningful role for Ivo in their business and can work together to make it real.
* **Be deeply analytical about where value is—and where it could be.** Identify and develop strategic growth opportunities. Partner closely with CSMs to understand customer adoption, usage trends, and business priorities. Use these insights to uncover whitespace, build compelling expansion opportunities, and engage the right stakeholders to turn potential into revenue.
* **Turn customer outcomes into a compelling case for investment.** Translate what Ivo helps customers achieve into business terms: less time spent reviewing agreements or finding answers, faster decisions, more consistent standards, and better visibility into contractual commitments and risk. Build credible business cases with clear baselines, explicit assumptions, and outcomes customers can measure. Help champions make the case internally, and lead thoughtful executive conversations about what matters, what needs to change, and why the next investment is worthwhile.
* **Help customers build toward Ivo as their system of record for contracts.** Develop a long-term vision with customers for how Ivo can become central to the way their organization works with contracts—not simply another tool used by one team. Connect that ambition to current capabilities and a practical sequence of use cases across Ivo’s expanding product portfolio. Help customers identify the stakeholders, workflow changes, and internal commitments needed to progress, so better access to contract knowledge positions their teams to move quickly and execute business decisions with confidence.
* **Run disciplined renewal and expansion cycles through close.** Own discovery, proposals, procurement, legal review, negotiation, and close. Build plans with clear next steps and decision owners, surface risk early, and maintain an evidence-based forecast. Maintain accurate forecasts and an up-to-date pipeline, working closely with your manager to ensure clear visibility into renewals and expansion opportunities.
* **Bring Ivo together around the customer.** Partner with CSMs, Solutions Architects, Legal Engineers, Product, and Finance, bringing them in when their expertise will help. Keep commercial ownership clear, stay accountable for follow-through rather than treating a handoff as the finish line, and bring precise customer feedback to Product. Turn what works into repeatable ways to grow your book.

**Skills You'll Need to Bring**
-------------------------------

* A track record of personally creating and closing expansion within existing software customers. You can explain the opportunity you uncovered, what you sold, who you brought into the decision, and the result. Account Executive backgrounds are welcome with strong active expansion experience preferred.Strong commercial ownership. You can lead renewal and expansion conversatio

Consociate Health, a leading Third-Party Administrator, offers an opportunity to grow and develop your career in an environment that provides a fulfilling workplace for employees, and creates continuous learning and embraces the ideas and diversity of others.

As part of our Mission to make Healthcare more accessible and affordable for our clients through innovation solutions and expert consultation, we value the inherent qualities that are foremost in our Mission, Vision, Values- Compassion, Humility and Impact, which allow us all to create authentic relationships with our team and our clients.

**POSITION SUMMARY:**

The Case Manager is responsible for managing and facilitating service and travel navigation for members eligible for specialized benefits. This role ensures seamless coordination of care at top-tier medical facilities for cancer care, assists with benefit navigation, eliminates barriers, ensures access to quality care and resolves financial concerns. The position also oversees clinical travel operations and addresses member inquiries while maintaining service level commitments. This is a full-time position (40 hours per week) with a 7-day on-call rotation. This position reports to the Advanced Care Program Manager.

**PRINCIPAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Member Coordination: Serve as the primary contact for an assigned caseload, verifying eligibility, processing referrals and conducting initial outreach within 24 hours of referral submission.
* Navigation & Support: Educate members on benefits, assist with provider coordination and address travel and financial concerns.
* Issue Resolution: Handle billing, claims, eligibility and correspondence inquiries, escalating unresolved issues as needed.
* Travel Coordination: Arrange accommodations, transportation and relocation for members and caregivers.
* Process Improvement: Identify workflow gaps, provide feedback for enhancements and ensure compliance with service standards.
* Documentation & Reporting: Maintain accurate records of member interactions, travel activities and financial transactions.
* Performance & Compliance: Meet established efficiency, call quality and accuracy goals.
* Act as a resource for team members and assist in training new staff.
* Oversee case assignments, queue coverage, and on-call scheduling.
* Ensure compliance with policies and procedures while addressing process improvements.
* Attend team lead meetings and contribute to training development.

**GENERAL EXPECTATIONS:**

* Present a positive image of Consociate Health at all times.
* Provide and promote the delivery of services with a prevailing attitude of respect and recognition of the personal worth and dignity of every individual whether they are a customer or co-worker.
* Communicate in a clear and concise manner, while also demonstrating receptivity through active listening.
* Identify and perform work that has not been specifically assigned, as needed.
* Continuously seek opportunities for improvement and suggest ways in which procedures/systems may be modified to accomplish tasks/goal efficiently and effectively.
* Demonstrate a teamwork philosophy by working cooperatively with others.
* Attend required in-service and staff meetings.
* Seek other educational opportunities directly related to this position.
* Preserve the confidentiality of all business-sensitive information, including but not limited to that of insured groups and individuals, employees and applicants.
* Adhere to established safety standards and utilizes proper techniques to avoid work-related injuries.

**BENEFITS:**

* Paid time off
* Paid Holidays
* Medical, Dental and Vision Insurance
* Basic Group Life, Short Term and Long Term Disability
* Voluntary Life, Critical Illness and Accident Coverage
* 401K Plan: Employees are immediately eligible with a 2% automatic enrollment. Consociate matches up to 4% of an employees' annual salary.

  
**Experience and Skills:**

**SERVICE EXPECTATIONS:**

* Greet all people in a prompt and courteous manner. Communicate in a warm and courteous manner, making eye contact and speaking in a tone of voice that matches words.
* Ask customers what they need and strive to exceed their expectations. Offer and provide assistance whether or not the request falls within your specific job duties.
* Respond to customer requests in a timely manner consistent with Consociate Health's standards and best practices, return calls promptly and keep them informed of delays before they ask.
* Make decisions based on customer needs, opinions, complaints or suggestions.
* Take appropriate steps to resolve problems to the customer's satisfaction.
* Ask customers for their opinions, accepting criticism as an opportunity to improve service.
* Seek opportunities, provide value-added services, and eliminate tasks that do not serve our customer.
* Remain aware of products and services provided by Consociate Health.
* Project a positive, professional image when working.

**KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITY REQUIREMENTS:**

* High school diploma or GED.
* 1-3 years of experience in customer service, travel, or healthcare.
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple tasks.
* Proficiency in Office 365, Adobe, and Excel.
* Ability to meet telecommuter requirements.
* Must be certified and maintain certification as a medical travel professional.
* College degree in healthcare, psychology, or a related field.
* 5+ years of relevant experience.
* Knowledge of medical terminology.

  
From: Consociate Health

jobs.description:
**Location**

Remote

**Employment Type**

Full time

Finance

  

fal is the generative media ecosystem powering the next generation of AI products. We build the infrastructure, tools, and model access that teams need to move from idea to production, and do it at scale without compromise. For developers and enterprises, fal is the foundation that makes generative media not just possible, but practical: a unified platform where high-performance inference, orchestration, and observability come together to unlock new categories of AI-native products.

As generative media reshapes industries across a market projected to grow by hundreds of billions over the next decade, fal is becoming the ecosystem that ambitious teams build on.

**About this role:**
--------------------

We're hiring an Accounting Operations Manager to own the operational core of fal's finance function: payables, spend management, procurement, and the books of our subsidiaries. You will work in Pacific Standard Time zone, run the weekly cadence that keeps vendors paid and spend under control, and you will turn the processes behind it into documented, audit-ready controls as fal completes its first financial statement audit and moves to a new ERP.

This is a hands-on role for someone who likes building processes as much as running it.

### **What you’ll do**

### **Spend management and AP oversight**

* Own Ramp administration and allocate and oversee workload carried by offshore supporting AP team
* Act as the first point of contact for employee and vendor questions on spend, declined transactions, and payment status.
* Review card transactions and reimbursements for policy compliance, receipt support, GL coding, and accrual cut-off, and follow up on exceptions until they close.

* Run the weekly payables cycle end to end: invoice intake, matching to PO and receipt, GL and department coding, and approval routing.
* Maintain the vendor master, including W-9 collection, bank-detail changes verified by call-back, and controls against payment fraud.
* Prepare the weekly payment batch with a cash-requirements summary for finance leadership approval.

### **Procurement and purchase orders**

* Collaborate with Finance, Legal, and Ops on scalable procurement processes, including approval thresholds by amount, department, and vendor risk.
* Partner with Legal and budget owners so contracts, POs, and invoices tie out before payment.

**Subsidiary accounting and intercompany**

* Keep the books for fal's subsidiaries under US GAAP, including journal entries, account reconciliations, and monthly close.
* Record, settle, and reconcile intercompany transactions and balances each month.
* Prepare elimination entries and support consolidation of entity financials.
* Bring acquired entities onto fal's chart of accounts, close calendar, and control environment.

### **Audit readiness and systems**

* Document process narratives and controls for AP, treasury, and procurement, and prepare the evidence auditors request.
* Help configure AP, procurement, and intercompany workflows in fal's new ERP.
* Use AI tools and automation to remove manual steps from invoice processing, coding, and reconciliations.

### **1099 reporting, tax and close support**

* Own 1099 readiness year-round: vendor classification, TIN matching, and complete W-9 and W-8 files.
* Prepare, review, and approve annual 1099-NEC and 1099-MISC filings, and handle corrections and IRS notices.
* Support Tax function on ad hoc basis, including sales and use tax, and property tax.
* Support the month end close process, including but not limited to reconciliations of prepaids, deposits, payables, accruals.

### **Qualifications/Nice-to-haves**

* 5+ years in accounting operations, accounts payable, or general accounting
* Bachelor's degree in Accounting or Finance.
* Hands-on experience running AP and spend management in Ramp, Brex, or Bill.com, integrated with an ERP.
* Strong working knowledge of US GAAP, month-end close, and balance sheet reconciliations.
* Exposure to foreign subsidiaries, multi-currency accounting, or post-acquisition integration.
* Direct experience preparing and filing 1099s.
* A track record of designing internal controls: segregation of duties, approval matrices, and audit evidence.
* Precise and organized, and comfortable owning a recurring cadence with hard deadlines.
* Clear written communication with vendors, employees, and auditors.
* Fluency with AI tools and workflow automation to scale finance operations.
* Experience at a venture-backed, high-growth technology company, ideally through a first audit.

* CPA, or progress toward licensure.
* ERP implementation or migration experience (NetSuite, Rillet, or similar).

### **What we offer at fal**

* Interesting and challenging work
* A lot of learning and growth opportunities
* We offer visa sponsorship and will help you relocate to San Francisco.
* Health, dental, and vision insurance (US)
* Regular team events and offsites

Our solutions turn that foundation into action: accurate data and continuous maintenance for teams managing a fragmented vendor master, sourcing intelligence built resolving even the hardest-to-identify suppliers, small, local, and diverse businesses, for teams tracking sustainability and compliance, and direct visibility for the suppliers themselves into where they stand with the enterprises that buy from them. To become a best-in-class in-house agency team, we need best-in-class creative operators-a secret sauce to setting the work up for success. To achieve this, we are establishing a Creative Operations Partnership model to fundamentally elevate how our creative organization operates.
  
  
As a Creative Operations Partner, you will serve as the creative operational arm and strategic business partner to our core Creative Leaders, helping them run their business with clarity, discipline, and scale. * Serve as the day-to-day operational and business management partner to Creative Leaders across planning, budgeting, prioritization, and measurement.

You will provide technical and engineering support as required by the projects needed. * Ensure the maintenance of all official project documentation and logs
* Provide directions to planning, scheduling and engineering functions
* Responsible for customer maintenance and other sales and marketing
* Maintain a thorough understanding of labor agreements and standards specific to projects

Minimum Qualifications

* BS in Electrical Engineering, Construction Management or IBEW Apprentice Training Certificate or equivalent in job experience.
* Superior communication skills, both written and verbal.

jobs.title: Implementation Manager - Enterprise
jobs.description:
A little about us…Fleetio is a modern software platform that helps thousands of organizations worldwide manage their fleet operations. Transportation technology is a hot market, and we’re leading the charge with raving fans and new customers signing up every day. We raised $450M in our Series D funding round in March of 2025 and are on an exciting trajectory as a company. Fleetio is also a proud founding member of the Rails Foundation!

**More about our team and company:**

* Fleetio overview video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YoXyXTFWbkg
* Our careers page: https://www.fleetio.com/careers

Fleetio’s largest customers don’t need a standard onboarding checklist; they need a trusted partner who can make a complex change feel manageable. As an Implementation Manager, you’ll lead a focused portfolio of Key and Enterprise customers through launches that can span teams, locations, data, and connected systems. You’ll shape the plan with customer leaders, help teams make sound rollout decisions, and see the impact as Fleetio becomes part of how their operations run. You’ll also help strengthen the way Fleetio delivers its most complex implementations.

This is a senior, customer-facing individual-contributor role. You’ll lead through project ownership and influence, partnering with customer executives and operators and with Fleetio teams across Sales, Product, Engineering, Support, and Customer Success.

### **What You’ll Do**

* Lead a focused portfolio of complex Enterprise implementations from post-sale handoff through launch and stabilization. Build a trusted partnership, understand what success means in the customer’s operation, and shape a rollout plan that fits the real-world need, not just the software setup.
* Bring the moving parts together. Turn discovery into a clear path forward, coordinating customer and Fleetio owners across workflows, data, configuration, integrations, testing, and rollout. Keep scope, responsibilities, and dependencies clear and documented, and bring in technical partners where needed.
* Make complexity manageable. Use pilots, phased rollouts, and readiness checkpoints to reduce risk; keep customer project leads and executives aligned; and surface risks or changed assumptions early with a practical recommendation.
* Set customers up to sustain the change. Make role-based training and adoption part of the plan, lead a thoughtful transition to Customer Success, and turn lessons from complex launches into better ways of working across Fleetio.

### **Your Experience**

* 5+ years in customer-facing SaaS implementation, enterprise onboarding, technical project delivery, or a related role, with direct ownership of complex implementations through launch.
* Experience guiding enterprise customers through multi-stakeholder, multi-location, or work-stream deployments.
* Strong project leadership: you can turn customer goals into a workable plan, coordinate parallel work-streams and dependencies, and reset expectations when conditions change.
* Clear, confident communication with customer operators, IT teams, project leads, and executives, including leading discovery, facilitating decisions, and navigating difficult conversations.
* Technical aptitude with data-heavy implementations, including migration, configuration, integrations, testing, and cutover. You know when to involve technical specialists and how to keep customer expectations grounded in confirmed scope.
* A consultative, detail-oriented approach to change management and adoption, with the judgment to manage risk and competing priorities while keeping customers moving toward sustainable use.

### **Helpful Experience**

* Experience implementing software for customers in fleet management, transportation, logistics, or field service.
* Familiarity with how fleet teams use maintenance, telematics, fuel, or ERP systems in their day-to-day operations.

### **Role Considerations**

* 15% Travel required to customer on-site workshops and internal meetings
* Some flexibility in working hours may be needed to coordinate with customer teams across time zones.

### **Benefits**

* Multiple health/dental coverage options (100% coverage for employee, 50% for family)
* Vision insurance
* Incentive stock options
* 401(k) match of 4%
* PTO - 4 weeks (increases at year two!)
* 12 company holidays + 2 floating holidays
* Parental leave - birthing parent (16 weeks paid) non-birthing (4 weeks paid)
* FSA & HSA options
* Short and long term disability (short term 100% paid)
* Community service funds
* Professional development funds
* Wellbeing fund - $150 quarterly
* Business expense stipend - $125 quarterly
* Mac laptop + new hire equipment stipend
* Fully stocked kitchen with tons of drinks & snacks (BHM only)
* Remote working friendly since 2012 #LI-Remote

jobs.title: Bus Project Manager
jobs.description:
We're looking for a **Bus Project Manager** to lead isolated phase (IPB), non-segregated and segregated phase bus duct projects at power generation, utility and industrial facilities across the U.S. You'll manage several projects at once, with overlapping schedules and values. Projects include new IPB installations, bus duct replacements and change-outs (for example, iso-phase to non-segregated bus), retrofits, and maintenance outages.

You'll own each project from quote to closeout. You'll work with engineering, field crews, subcontractors, equipment vendors and customers such as plant owners, EPCs and utilities. You'll join a mission-driven team that values safety, execution and continuous improvement.

**What You’ll Do:**

* Lead assigned bus duct projects through every phase, from kickoff to closeout, delivering on time and within budget
* Prepare project quotes and estimates, including site visits to assess existing equipment and installation conditions
* Define scope, deliverables, schedules and budgets with customers and internal stakeholders
* Develop and review designs for IPB, non-segregated and segregated bus runs and related switchgear interfaces, using AutoCAD
* Make sure designs meet customer specifications and applicable industry standards (e.g., IEEE C37.23)
* Perform engineering reviews, start corrective actions, and support technical troubleshooting
* Schedule projects with customers and plan around outage windows
* Plan and coordinate field resources: crews, subcontractors, equipment rentals (cranes, manlifts, scaffolding) and material deliveries
* Lead project kickoff meetings and serve as the main point of contact for customers
* Direct and coordinate onsite crews and subcontractors during installation, change-out and startup
* Manage contracts and keep projects compliant on both technical and commercial terms
* Track progress, costs and change orders; identify risks and put contingency plans in place
* Monitor subcontractor performance and issue RFPs as needed
* Make sure field work meets all safety standards and regulatory requirements, including OSHA and site-specific rules
* Communicate clearly and consistently with internal and external teams

**The Experience We’re Looking For:**

* 5+ years of experience overseeing bus duct, switchgear or electrical distribution projects
* Knowledge of isolated phase, non-segregated and segregated phase bus duct: design, installation, replacement and startup
* Experience preparing project quotes and estimates, including onsite assessments
* Experience supervising field installations at multiple sites, from small maintenance jobs to large multi-unit installs
* Understanding of the power generation industry, EPC relationships and outage-driven scheduling
* Strong leadership, organizational and problem-solving skills
* Proven communication skills with crews, subcontractors and customers
* Skilled in Microsoft Project and the MS Office Suite

**Additional Requirements:**

* Willingness to travel up to 25%-30% across the continental U.S.
* Bachelor's degree in engineering, construction management, business or a related technical field, or equivalent work experience
* Must successfully complete a background check and pre-employment/random drug tests
* Comfortable visiting power plants and industrial sites with varied temperatures (20–100°F), noise levels, heights and PPE requirements
* Valid driver’s license
* Legally authorized to work in the United States

**Bonus Points for:**

* Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings; 2D/3D drafting experience (AutoCAD or similar) strongly preferred
* Experience with complete IPB installations, especially new-build combined-cycle or other generation projects
* Experience with bus duct change-outs coordinated with breaker or switchgear work
* Sheet-metal fabrication knowledge and familiarity with bus duct manufacturing processes
* OSHA 30 certification; rigging and signaling, crane, manlift, forklift or scaffold training
* Familiarity with IEEE/ANSI bus duct standards, NETA standards and PMO methodologies
* PMP certification

**Why Join RMS Energy:**

We’re not just another power services company. We’re a tight-knit, mission-driven team that values safety, teamwork, innovation, and continuous growth.

* **Full Benefits** – Medical, dental, and vision coverage fully paid for employees, starting the month after hire

* **401(k) with Company Match** – Traditional & Roth options + free investment guidance
* **Education Support** – Paid training, certifications, and industry memberships
* **Generous PTO** – Paid vacation, holidays, and sick leave
* **Employee Assistance Program** – Legal, financial, and mental wellness support

jobs.title: HR Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Company Description**

Mission Critical Group (MCG) is a U.S.-based electrical systems and solutions provider that reduces time-to-power through its broad product portfolio, modular solutions, and more than one million square feet of U.S. manufacturing capacity.

We bring design, manufacturing, and advanced services together to deliver power reliability, scalability, and speed.

 **Job Description**

The HR Operations Coordinator is responsible for supporting centralized Human Resources programs and operational initiatives across Mission Critical Group (MCG) and its subsidiaries. This position supports program administration within established policies and procedures, tracks activity and trends, and escalates issues and recommendations to the HR Operations Partner.The role serves as MCG's day-to-day contact with Thomas & Company for unemployment claims and tracks vendor service levels and program activity.Additional responsibilities include supporting WOTC administration, tuition reimbursement, professional development, employee recognition initiatives, and centralized HR service delivery.The position partners with HR leadership and business stakeholders to implement approved initiatives, strengthen program effectiveness, and support consistent HR operations across MCG.

 **Qualifications**

**Unemployment Claims Administration**

* Serve as MCG’s day-to-day point of contact with Thomas & Company for unemployment claims across MCG and its subsidiaries.
* Coordinate with Thomas & Company to support timely, accurate unemployment claim responses and compliance with applicable state deadlines.
* Gather, review, and provide employment separation information, attendance records, disciplinary documentation, and other supporting materials requested for claims.
* Partner with HR Business Partners, Payroll, and business leaders to obtain complete and accurate information for Thomas & Company.
* Monitor open claims, requests for information, determinations, hearings, appeals, and outstanding items through the vendor’s platform.
* Coordinate hearing and appeal preparation with Thomas & Company and appropriate internal stakeholders.
* Maintain organized records of claim activity, determinations, supporting documents, and vendor correspondence.
* Provide HR leadership with unemployment claim activity reports, trends, and identified opportunities for improvement.
* Escalate complex claims, disputed matters, and potential compliance concerns to the HR Operations Partner or appropriate HR leadership.
* Track claim trends and appeal outcomes and report them to the HR Operations Partner, who manages the Thomas & Company relationship.

**Work Opportunity Tax Credit (WOTC) Administration**

* Support the centralized WOTC program and maintain records in the associated vendor platform.
* Monitor employee screening activity, application submissions, certification status, and outstanding documentation.
* Review program records for completeness and coordinate resolution of missing or inaccurate information.
* Maintain documentation supporting tax credit eligibility, certification, and reporting requirements.
* Monitor program participation and provide regular updates regarding submission activity, certifications, and potential tax credit opportunities.
Identify opportunities to improve program participation, efficiency, and data accuracy.  

**Tuition Reimbursement and Professional Development Programs**

* Coordinate required approvals with business leaders, HR, and other designated stakeholders.
* Track approved requests, educational programs, reimbursement amounts, completion documentation, and applicable repayment obligations.
* Coordinate with Payroll and Finance to support accurate and timely reimbursement processing.
* Maintain program records and monitor expenditures against approved budgets.
* Serve as a resource for employees and managers regarding program eligibility, application requirements, and reimbursement procedures.
* Partner with business leaders to support employee development initiatives and consistent program administration.
Identify opportunities to improve employee participation and streamline program processes.  

**Centralized HR Inbox and Employee Support**

* Manage and monitor the centralized MCG HR inbox to ensure employee and manager inquiries receive timely and professional responses.
* Serve as an initial point of contact for general HR questions regarding company policies, procedures, programs, and available resources.
* Research and respond to routine HR inquiries within established guidelines and authority.

* Track outstanding inquiries and follow up with responsible parties to support timely resolution.
* Identify recurring questions, service issues, and opportunities to improve employee communications and HR service delivery.

jobs.title: HEDIS & Quality Data Operations Lead
jobs.description:
**About Us**

Fenyx Health is an innovative, fast-growing Medicare Savings Account (MSA) health plan dedicated to transforming healthcare delivery and empowering Medicare beneficiaries. With strong foundational quality work already underway, we are seeking a hands-on, organized operational owner to standardize, strengthen, and manage the HEDIS and quality data operations backbone that drives our CMS Star Ratings and Quality Improvement initiatives.

**Role Overview**

The Lead of HEDIS & Quality Data Operations will play a foundational role in organizing and scaling our health plan’s quality operations as a senior individual contributor. Reporting to the VP of Strategic Partnerships, you will serve as the end-to-end operational owner for HEDIS execution and annual NCQA audits, as well as the operational business owner for CAHPS and HOS survey vendors. Because Fenyx Health operates non-network MSA plans—where members have high-deductible freedom of choice without traditional PCP gatekeeping or Part D coverage—capturing accurate clinical data through non-standard supplemental feeds and medical record retrieval is essential to reflecting true care quality. You will define clear data requirements for internal and contracted IT teams, validate incoming vendor feeds, coordinate HEDIS care gap closure across internal teams and external partners, and maintain ongoing performance forecasting to maximize Star Rating outcomes.

**Key Responsibilities**

**End-to-End HEDIS Operations, Annual Audit & Survey Vendor Management:**

* Serve as the primary operational owner and main point of contact for external data vendors, certified HEDIS submission partners, vendor technical leads, and CMS-approved CAHPS/HOS survey vendors.
* Establish and manage vendor SLAs, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and quality control workflows—conducting periodic internal audits of incoming vendor and supplemental data feeds (EHR, clinical, claims, encounters, lab, and registries) to ensure ongoing accuracy and timeliness.
* Manage operational execution and data submission timelines for HEDIS, CAHPS, and HOS (including mock survey administration) to ensure 100% on-time, error-free reporting in partnership with Compliance.
* Own the annual HEDIS audit lifecycle end-to-end—serving as the primary liaison with NCQA-certified auditors and technical leads to validate data completeness, manage HEDIS Roadmap submissions, and complete primary source verification (PSV).

**Technical Specification Mastery, Data Requirements & Supplemental Feeds:**

* Apply deep expertise in NCQA HEDIS technical specifications, CMS Star Ratings Technical Notes, and CAHPS/HOS sampling rules to identify data gaps, logic discrepancies, and missed clinical capture opportunities.
* Define clear business and technical data requirements (specifying required data elements, layouts, and delivery schedules) for internal and contracted IT resources and vendors and perform thorough QA on resulting file outputs and occasional sFTP file transfers.
* Maximize clinical data capture across Fenyx Health’s non-network MSA member population by expanding standard and non-standard supplemental data feeds, EMR/HIE connectivity, and medical record retrieval workflows in strict adherence to NCQA audit standards.

**HEDIS Gap Closure Coordination & Performance Forecasting:**

* Run ongoing predictive performance models and measure-level cut-point forecasting against CMS technical specifications to identify at-risk HEDIS, CAHPS, and HOS measures early.
* Coordinate all operational aspects of HEDIS care gap closure—generating member and provider target gap lists, tracking closure velocity, and collaborating closely with internal outreach teams and external clinical/vendor partners (while internal outreach teams execute direct member calls).
* Monitor intra-year measure performance and mock survey results, building clear operational and executive dashboards to provide real-time visibility into HEDIS and Star Rating trajectories.

**Process Standardization & Cross-Functional Collaboration:**

* Organize, standardize, and streamline existing quality workflows into documented, repeatable SOPs and data governance routines suited for a fast-growing MSA health plan.
* Partner closely with internal and contracted IT, Clinical Operations, Member Experience, Actuarial, and Compliance teams to ensure seamless data flow, audit readiness, and timely gap closure.

**Qualifications**

**Required:**

* **Experience:** 3–5+ years of direct experience in Medicare Advantage quality operations, specifically leading HEDIS reporting, NCQA audits, and quality data management (with working knowledge of CAHPS and HOS survey operations).
* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in a healthcare-related field.
* **Technical Expertise:** Deep, hands-on knowledge of NCQA HEDIS technical specifications, supplemental data validation rules, CMS Star Ratings cut-point methodology, and CAHPS/HOS survey administration and sampling rules.
* **Vendor & Operations Management:** Proven track record managing certified HEDIS vendors, third-party clinical/supplemental data feeds, CAHPS/HOS survey vendors, and leading end-to-end NCQA HEDIS audits (including Roadmap and PSV).
* **Analytical Acumen:** Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Google Sheets, plus working familiarity with certified HEDIS platforms, healthcare file layouts, and sFTP file transfers, with the ability to translate complex data into clear operational forecasts and dashboards.
* **Data Governance & Quality Assurance:** Thorough understanding of Medicare data structures (claims, encounters, enrollment, lab, and EHR clinical feeds), vendor data auditing, and NCQA supplemental data compliance standards.

**Preferred:**

* Experience working within a startup, early-stage, or rapid-growth health plan environment where organizing and standardizing evolving workflows is required.
* Familiarity with the unique operational and benefit nuances of non-network

jobs.title: Sr. Specialist, Customer Success
jobs.description:
Specialty Networks is an integrated, multi-specialty organization with GPOs, Life Sciences, and Research solutions in Urology, Oncology, Gastroenterology, and Rheumatology. Specialty Networks solutions include population health management, patient engagement, clinical research, and workflow automation technologies to achieve Center of Excellence status in Standards of Care, Clinical Research, Practice Operations, and Value-based Care. Specialty Networks leverages the Power of its Network, represented by over 10,000 providers, to help independent physician practices, industry, wholesalers/distributors, payers, and policymakers improve patient outcomes

**Job Summary**  
  
The Sr. Specialist, Customer Success, or Customer Success Associate (CSA), supports the Customer Success team in delivering a responsive, organized, and high-quality experience for existing pharmaceutical customers. The role assists with client onboarding, project coordination, meeting preparation, follow-up, account documentation, renewal readiness, and sales/Business Development support. Working under the guidance of experienced Customer Success Managers and the Customer Success Manager Team Lead, the CSA builds foundational knowledge in customer success, healthcare analytics, and Real-world Data/Evidence while taking ownership of defined tasks and smaller client workstreams.

* Serve as a trusted partner to assigned customers, supporting successful delivery of analytics, insights, and Real-World Data/Evidence engagements while ensuring a positive customer experience.
* Partner with Business Development Directors and Customer Success Managers to maintain account continuity, support customer discussions, and identify opportunities to enhance customer value and engagement.
* Coordinate customer onboarding, project kickoffs, training activities, business reviews, and ongoing engagement activities.
* Prepare and manage meeting agendas, presentations, status updates, action logs, follow-up communications, and other customer-facing materials.
* Schedule and coordinate internal and customer meetings, ensuring stakeholders, materials, and logistics are aligned.
* Track project milestones, deliverables, risks, dependencies, and action items; provide status updates and escalate issues as appropriate.

* Support customer adoption and value realization by coordinating deliverables, follow-up activities, training sessions, and routine check-ins.
* Respond to routine customer inquiries and facilitate collaboration with internal teams and subject matter experts to address customer needs.

jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description:
**About Reserv**

Reserv is an insurtech creating and incubating cutting-edge AI and automation technology to bring efficiency and simplicity to claims. Founded by insurtech veterans with deep experience in SaaS and digital claims, Reserv is venture-backed by Bain Capital and Altai Ventures and began operations in May 2022. We are focused on automating highly manual tasks to tackle long-standing problems in claims and set a new standard for TPAs, insurance technology providers, and adjusters alike. We have ambitious (but attainable!) goals and need people who can work in an evolving environment. If building a leading TPA and the prospect of tackling the long-standing challenges of the claims role sounds exciting, we can’t wait to meet you.

**Location Requirement**

Candidates must reside in an eligible U.S. state throughout employment. We are unable to hire candidates residing in **California, Alaska, Hawaii, U.S. territories, or outside the United States.**

**About the role**

Reports to the Sr. Director of Program Management. The Account Management team owns Reserv's customer relationships beginning in onboarding: we are the customer's single point of contact, the people who make sure claims service matches what was promised, and the reason customers renew and grow.  
  
Our book is growing, and so are the programs inside it. This role owns a portfolio of customers and programs - MGAs, carriers, and self-insureds - and delivers our service model to each of them at the standard we publish. You run the reviews, keep the program data right, and work with our claims, operations, finance, and data science teams to fix what needs fixing before the customer has to ask.  
  
You will be an excellent fit if you know how a claim moves from first notice to close, you are comfortable walking a customer through their reporting, and you would rather prevent a problem than explain one.  
  
We hire owners. You see the whole outcome through, go to the details yourself, and keep a customer's confidence by being candid and keeping your word. You use sound judgment and look past today's fix to what would make the program better.

**What you'll do**  
  
**Customer Ownership:** Own the relationship for an assigned portfolio of customers and programs as their primary point of contact, from onboarding onward. Deliver our service model at the published cadence for every customer, and acknowledge and resolve escalations within our service levels.  
  
**Onboarding and Launch:** Lead customer-facing onboarding for your programs and run the 30, 60, and 90 day reviews after launch. Make sure each program lands the way it was sold.  
  
**Business and Claim Reviews:** Prepare, deliver, and follow up on business reviews and claim reviews. Run a monthly internal review of every program you hold, so you walk into each customer conversation knowing where the program stands.  
  
**Program Operations:** Work with our internal teams to make sure billing, claim routing, and reporting are done correctly, and own the issues and escalations that come out of them. When something breaks, drive it to resolution and close the loop with the customer.  
  
**Data Accuracy and Insight:** Keep program data accurate in the CRM and the revenue forecast, and keep volume forecasts current. Be data fluent: translate program data into valuable insights for each customer. Take in customer analytics requests, prioritize them, and work with our data science team to see them built, validated, and delivered.  
  
**Retention and Growth:** Monitor the health of each relationship and raise risk early. Identify growth opportunities, bring them to our commercial team, and support the effort to win them.

**Requirements**

* 4+ years in claims, program management, or account management
* Working knowledge of the claim lifecycle and reporting
* Able to prepare and run a business review and a claim review with a customer
* Data fluent: able to translate data into valuable insights for a customer
Clear, professional communicator - in writing and live* - who keeps customers informed before they have to ask
* Organized enough to keep every account's records, forecasts, and follow-ups current without being reminded
* A record of owning outcomes end to end and delivering on your commitments
* Bachelor's degree (lack of one should not stop you from applying if you possess all the other qualifications)

**Benefits**

* Generous health-insurance package with nationwide coverage, vision, & dental
* 401(k) retirement plan with employer matching
* Competitive PTO policy – we want our employees fresh, healthy, happy, and energized!
* Generous family leave policy after 8 months of continuous work
* 100% remote (home-based) role designed to support your work-life balance paired with frequent, regular corporate retreats to build team cohesion, reinforce culture, and have fun
* Apple laptop, large second monitor, and other quality-of-life equipment you may want. Technology is something that should make your life easier, not harder!

At Reserv, we value diversity in backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences and believe that diversity in viewpoints and critical thinking drives innovation, first-principles thinking, and success. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and encourage those from all walks of life to apply. If you believe you are a good fit for this role, we would love to hear from you!

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager (YouTube Agency)
jobs.description:
Viral Bangers is a fully remote YouTube agency. We write scripts, edit videos and design thumbnails for experts, founders and trading educators, including vidIQ, Jordan Welch and Chamath Palihapitiya. Their channel is a big part of their business, so they care how it's going.

We need the person our clients talk to every day. When a script is late or a thumbnail needs another pass, they hear it from you, along with a plan.

What you'll do

- Check where each client's videos are in ClickUp every morning, and tell each client what's moving and what we still need from them

- Chase whatever is holding things up: raw footage, a script approval, a thumbnail pick

- Turn feedback like "make it punchier" into clear tasks for the editor or writer, and follow up until they're done

- Talk to clients on Slack, sometimes WhatsApp. When a thread passes ten messages, jump on a call or send a Loom

- If a video will be late, tell the client before they ask

- Once a week, go through each client: uploads on time? happy? anything they haven't said?

- Back the team when the client is wrong, and find a fair middle

You're a fit if

- Your English is strong, written and spoken

- You've managed clients directly before (customer success, account management or an agency). Knowing YouTube is a plus

- You reach out when a client goes quiet. Nobody has to tell you

- You stay calm when a client is upset, and you can still say no

Not a fit if you wait for instructions, treat every client the same, or think the client is always right.

Pay

- USD 800/month base, covering your first 5 clients

- USD 160/month for each client after that

- Paid on results, not hours, so it doesn't have to be full time. The first 2-3 weeks take more time while you learn the clients

Apply only through our role page: https://www.viralbangers.com/careers/customer-success-manager

Fill in the form there and paste the link to your Loom (English, on camera, 3 minutes max, answering the 6 questions in the job description; no reading, script or edits). Applications without a Loom aren't reviewed. Applications sent by email or DM aren't reviewed either.

Process (we reply to every step within 24 hours)

1. Apply with the form AND a Loom. Applications without a Loom won't be reviewed.

2. A 45-minute task with 3 real client cases. You have 24 hours.

3. A short call with our team, including a 5-minute role-play where we play an upset client.

4. A paid 1-week trial (USD 200) with 2 real clients. We read your messages before they go out.

The Loom (required, English, 3 minutes max). Answer these 6 questions:

1. Who are you, and where have you managed clients?

2. A new client just signed. How do you build the relationship in the first 30 days?

3. How do you adapt how you talk to different clients? Give a real example.

4. A time you were stuck between a client and your team, and both had a point. What did you do?

5. A client wants to leave. What do you do in the first 48 hours?

6. Which client relationship are you proudest of, and why?

Loom rules: on camera, talking to us like a normal conversation. No reading, no teleprompter, no script and no edits. We reject read or edited Looms automatically. Set the link so anyone with it can view.

Pay: $55,800.00 - $67,300.00 per year

Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
#### **About the role**

Roasters, cafes and producers know their coffee. As a **Customer Success Manager**, you help them run the business around it: onboarding, adoption, renewals and growth. Cropster keeps 95% of its customers after 15 years. You help us keep it that way, one relationship at a time.  
  
You listen first, understand what each customer is trying to achieve, and show how Cropster gets them there. You manage your portfolio independently, and you work with Product, Marketing and Support when a customer needs more than one person can give.  
This is a fully remote role. For optimal team collaboration across global time zones, you regularly work flexibly in US Eastern or Central time hours, so you overlap with customers and the team.

#### **What you'll do**

**Look after your customer portfolio**

* Know where every account stands: priorities, risks, renewals and growth opportunities.
* Balance onboarding, trials, renewals, billing questions, support issues and commercial opportunities, and ask for help early when priorities collide.
* Keep CRM records current: interactions, account health and next steps.

**Help customers adopt Cropster and stay**

* Guide customers from trial through onboarding with clear next steps and regular contact.
* Hold regular check-ins to connect product features to customer goals, and follow up on every open action.
* Watch engagement and adoption to spot churn risks early, and talk about them openly with the customer.
* Lead discovery calls and product demos with existing accounts.

**Grow accounts**

* Spot expansion, upsell and cross-sell opportunities, including added services and subscription upgrades, and follow them through.
* Reach out to inactive customers and rebuild the relationship.
* Analyze account performance and give customers practical recommendations.
* Work towards agreed targets for retention, expansion revenue, outreach and pipeline, with a clear status and next step for every opportunity.

**Work together**

* Bring customer feedback and feature requests to Product and Marketing.
* Work with colleagues across teams so customers hear one answer, not three.

**What success looks like**

* Customers hear from you proactively and get timely follow-up.
* Trials, onboarding and commercial opportunities always have a next step.
* You know the health, risks, renewals and growth opportunities across your portfolio.
* Your pipeline and CRM data are accurate.
* You keep your commitments and show progress against agreed retention and revenue targets.

#### **We are looking for someone with**

* A degree in business, marketing or a related field, or equivalent experience in Customer Success.
* Several years in Customer Success or customer service, ideally in B2B SaaS, with a record of improving retention and satisfaction.
* Experience managing a high-volume portfolio while keeping contact consistent.
* Professional working proficiency in English and Spanish, written and spoken. Portuguese is a plus.
* Clear, concise communication and real care for your customer’s outcome.
* Commercial awareness: you notice risks and revenue opportunities and follow them through.
* Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to prioritize competing tasks.
* Proven ability to work independently in a remote environment.
* Initiative and follow-through, and openness about where you need support.
* Analytical and problem-solving skills.
* The ability to adapt when priorities change.

#### **That said, we’d be particularly delighted to hire someone with**

* Experience in the coffee industry, or familiarity with Cropster’s products or market.
* Hands-on experience with a CRM such as HubSpot or Salesforce.
* An understanding of technical SaaS products and subscription models.
* Availability for occasional travel to industry events and customer visits (15-20%). If travel is difficult for you, tell us and we’ll talk.

You don’t need to tick every box. If this role sounds like you, apply. We welcome applications from everyone, regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, religion or background. If you need adjustments during the hiring process, let us know and we’ll arrange them.

#### **What you can expect**

The base salary range for this position is **$70K to $80K USD gross base/year** + 20% variable compensation potential. We look at factors like your experience, location and individual qualifications to determine our offer. Additional benefits include medical, dental and vision health plans, employer-provided HRA, 401k with employer contribution, budgets for education & wellbeing, and professional development, a co-working benefit to support remote work, very flexible working hours without core hours, paid time for volunteer work, access to mental health support, and discounts for really great coffee. We also make our best possible offer upfront - no games!  
  
**Hiring timeline**: We are starting the interview process now and aim to hire by mid-January 2027. Interested but concerned about the timeline, apply and leave a note

#### **Apply now**

We look forward to receiving your application! If you have any questions, don't hesitate to contact our team at jobs@cropster.com.  
  
This position is open for immediate hire. Currently, Cropster will only employ those who are legally authorized to work in the US for this opening.

#### **About us**

Cropster is a team of coffee enthusiasts. We build the platform that connects coffee workflows from bean to cup.

As a Certified B Corp™, we work to make coffee more sustainable, transparent, and community-driven, and to amplify our positive impact along the way.

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager (CSM)- Billing & RCM Experience
jobs.description:
***Customer Success Manager, Billing and RCM***

**Job Overview**

Opus is a fully integrated EHR, CRM, and RCM platform built for behavioral health, substance use, eating disorder, psychiatry, and psychology practices. Our mission is to transform behavioral health care for 4 million patients by 2028.

**The Role**

Own the rollout of Opus RCM for every customer, from signed contract to a billing team that runs it with confidence. You implement the platform, configure it to the customer's payer mix and levels of care, train and coach their staff, take them live, and stay with them until clean claims are flowing.

This isn't a billing role, but it needs billing chops. You have to speak the language of billers, billing managers, and CFOs to earn their trust, find what's actually going wrong, and teach them to fix it. You teach the customer's team to run their revenue cycle on Opus RCM; you don't run it for them. Practices switch billing systems to fix something specific: claims that keep rejecting, AR aging past 90 days, a billing team fighting its own software. Going live is the means, not the goal. You get the customer to the result they switched for and show them the evidence. You won't do it alone. You work closely with our Customer Success Managers and Implementations team, who implement and train the EHR, with Support, and with our RCM services team.

**Who Thrives Here**

This role suits someone who has billed in behavioral health, run projects, and loves teaching, and who would rather build something than inherit it. The attributes that matter most:

* ***Billing fluency***. You know the revenue cycle well enough to talk shop with any biller or CFO. When a claim rejects, you can tell whether it's configuration, documentation, workflow, or the payer.
* ***Teaching that sticks***. You know adults learn by doing. You build training around the customer's real workflows, check for understanding, and coach until their team can do it without you.
* ***Project discipline***. You run several implementations at once against dates and go-live criteria, and every stakeholder knows what's next and who owns it.
* ***Empathy with boundaries***. You understand the pressure a billing team is under when cash is late, and you stay on their side. You also tell them plainly when a request is out of scope, a delay is on their end, or a workflow isn't supported, without damaging the relationship.
* ***Entrepreneurial spirit***. You build the training materials, checklists, and processes you wish existed, and improve them with every customer.
* ***Curiosity***. The problem a customer reports is often a symptom. You dig until you find the real cause, because only that fix holds.
* ***Persistence***. Open items, stalled enrollments, and half-finished configurations get pursued to closure.

**Responsibilities**

Onboarding & Implementation

* Run multiple concurrent Opus RCM implementations to scope, timeline, and go-live criteria, for new customers and for existing customers moving from another billing platform
* Set up clearinghouse connections and configure payers, fee schedules, and billing rules to each customer's payer mix and levels of care
* Map the customer's billing workflows and close the gaps between intake, clinical documentation, and claims
* Plan the customer's transition off their outgoing billing system so no AR is stranded
* Training & Coaching
* Design and deliver live training for billers, billing managers, and front desk staff, built on the customer's own workflows
* Coach the customer's team on live data after go-live until they run Opus RCM on their own
* Certify customer billing super-users
* Build and maintain the training materials, guides, and recordings the team reuses
* Retrain for staff turnover, new payers, and new features
* Working Across Teams
* Partner with the CSM and Implementations team so the EHR and RCM rollouts run as one plan, with one go-live story for the customer
