jobs.title: Account Manager, SME Accounts
jobs.description:
**About Reserv**

Reserv is an insurtech creating and incubating cutting-edge AI and automation technology to bring efficiency and simplicity to claims. Founded by insurtech veterans with deep experience in SaaS and digital claims, Reserv is venture-backed by Bain Capital and Altai Ventures and began operations in May 2022. We are focused on automating highly manual tasks to tackle long-standing problems in claims and set a new standard for TPAs, insurance technology providers, and adjusters alike. We have ambitious (but attainable!) goals and need people who can work in an evolving environment. If building a leading TPA and the prospect of tackling the long-standing challenges of the claims role sounds exciting, we can’t wait to meet you.

**Location Requirement**

Candidates must reside in an eligible U.S. state throughout employment. We are unable to hire candidates residing in **California, Alaska, Hawaii, U.S. territories, or outside the United States.**

**About the role**

Reports to the Sr. Director of Program Management. The Account Management team owns Reserv's customer relationships beginning in onboarding: we are the customer's single point of contact, the people who make sure claims service matches what was promised, and the reason customers renew and grow.  
  
Our customer base has grown fast. This role owns a portfolio of roughly 30 MGA, carrier, and self-insured customers and is their reliable, responsive partner at Reserv. The work is high volume and hands-on: lots of inbound, lots of follow-through, and full attention for every customer in the book.  
  
You will be an excellent fit if you are the most organized person on most teams you join, you answer fast and close the loop every time, and you like building the systems that let one person run a big book well. If you have helped a young company go from a handful of clients to dozens - and built the process to support it - we especially want to talk to you.  
  
We hire owners. You see the whole outcome through, go to the details yourself, and keep a customer's confidence by being candid and keeping your word. You use sound judgment and look past today's fix to what would make the program better.

**What you'll do**  
  
**Book Ownership:** Own the relationship for a portfolio of about 30 customers as their primary point of contact. Keep context across every account - open issues, key contacts, recent claims activity - so customers never have to repeat themselves.  
  
**Issue Resolution and Follow-Through:** Drive inbound questions, service issues, and escalations to resolution, working with our claims, operations, finance, and data science teams to get answers. Close the loop with the customer every time, and spot repeat issues so they get fixed at the root.  
  
**Retention at Scale:** Maintain a consistent touchpoint cadence across the book, monitor account health, and raise risk early. Make sure every customer gets the same quality of response and attention.  
  
**Systems and Scalability:** Build and maintain the infrastructure that lets a high-volume book run well - CRM hygiene, templates, cadences, and playbooks. Find the manual work that slows the book down and fix it, so the book can grow without anything getting missed.  
  
**Data and Insight:** Be data fluent. Pull and explain claims data, and translate it into valuable insights for each customer. Spot trends across your accounts and flag risks and growth opportunities to leadership.

**Requirements**

* 3+ years in account management, customer success, or client services, ideally carrying a book of 20+ accounts at once
* Highly organized: you run many accounts in parallel without dropping threads, and you can show us how you do it
Fast, professional communicator - in writing and live* - who keeps customers informed before they have to ask
* A problem solver who works across teams to get issues closed, not just passed along
* Data fluent: able to translate data into valuable insights for a customer
* Working knowledge of P&C insurance or claims; deep specialization in a single line of business is not required
* Startup experience growing a client base (say, from 2 clients to 50) and building the processes behind it is a strong plus
* A record of owning outcomes end to end and delivering on your commitments
* Bachelor's degree (lack of one should not stop you from applying if you possess all the other qualifications)

**Benefits**

* Generous health-insurance package with nationwide coverage, vision, & dental
* 401(k) retirement plan with employer matching
* Competitive PTO policy – we want our employees fresh, healthy, happy, and energized!
* Generous family leave policy after 8 months of continuous work
* 100% remote (home-based) role designed to support your work-life balance paired with frequent, regular corporate retreats to build team cohesion, reinforce culture, and have fun
* Apple laptop, large second monitor, and other quality-of-life equipment you may want. Technology is something that should make your life easier, not harder!

At Reserv, we value diversity in backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences and believe that diversity in viewpoints and critical thinking drives innovation, first-principles thinking, and success. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and encourage those from all walks of life to apply. If you believe you are a good fit for this role, we would love to hear from you!

jobs.title: Senior Business Development & Key Account Manager
jobs.description:
Cryoport Systems is a comprehensive supply chain partner for the life sciences industry, delivering specialized solutions to meet the challenges of the biopharmaceutical, cell and gene therapy, reproductive medicine, and animal health markets. Our offerings span logistics, BioServices and biostorage, cryopreservation, and consulting, ensuring the highest standards of quality and reliability for sensitive materials. With our expansive platform of management solutions and decades of temperature-controlled supply chain expertise, Cryoport Systems helps Enable the Outcome™ by supporting certainty and precision in the supply chain, whether advancing groundbreaking therapies, supporting families on their reproductive journeys, or enhancing animal health programs.

**POSITION SUMMARY**

The Senior Business Development & Key Account Manager - Americas is responsible for winning and growing medium to large, multi-site customers for Tec4med's real-time condition monitoring solutions across the United States (Americas).

  

The role is primarily focused on new business: building qualified pipeline, leading consultative, multi-stakeholder sales cycles and closing. Once won, the role-holder owns these accounts long term, expanding usage across sites, lanes and products, while continuing to develop new business pipeline.

The position will be responsible for growing our US territory for Tec4med. The role requires a very hands-on approach and an end-to-end ownership of the sales cycle, including lead generation and cold calling.The role targets customers with medium to large, multi-site monitoring requirements and medium to high shipment or asset volumes, in the following segments:

* End users / shippers - pharmaceutical, biotech, cell & gene therapy and other owners of high value, temperature-sensitive product who acquire the technology directly or specify it to their chosen logistics partners.
* Logistics service providers - 3PLs, freight forwarders, specialty couriers and packaging / asset pool providers who deploy Tec4med within their own services, as customers or as channel partners.
* Target industries - Biopharma (including cell & gene therapy, vaccines and biologics), CRO / CDMO, Laboratories, Animal Health and Reproductive Medicine / IVF, across shipment monitoring and on-site storage monitoring (cryogenic, dry ice / ULT, cold chain and CRT).
* Channel partners - logistics service providers, packaging and asset-pool providers who resell, integrate or white-label Tec4med within their own offering, with joint go-to-market to their end customers.

**PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES (include but are not limited to)**

  

* Generate new business and establish strong relationships with clients in the Americas region, focusing on medium to large, multi-site accounts in the target segments.
* Build and maintain a qualified pipeline in HubSpot that meets agreed coverage targets, and forecast accurately.
* Lead consultative, multi-stakeholder sales cycles  engaging quality / validation, supply chain, logistics, procurement, IT / security and commercial stakeholders - from discovery through business case, pilot / qualification and contract.
* Prepare and deliver accurate, customer-specific proposals and business cases, including recurring-revenue (service / subscription) models.
* Collaborate with inside sales support to provide accurate quotes and order processing.
* Conduct prospecting, digital outreach (LinkedIn, Email, and others), cold calls and video meetings to engage prospects and provide demos.
* Visit clients regularly to strengthen relationships and address their needs.
* Own won accounts long term: develop account plans for key accounts, drive roll-out across sites, lanes and products, and grow recurring revenue.
* Develop logistics service providers as customers and channel partners, including joint go-to market activity with their end customers.
* Work with Cryoport Systems, MVE and CRYOGENE colleagues on joint opportunities, while building an independent Tec4Med pipeline.
* Work with Customer Success / Validation colleagues to support customer qualification, onboarding and adoption.
* Represent the company at trade shows to increase visibility and generate leads.
* Contribute to developing and executing sales strategies for regional growth.
* Support marketing efforts by aligning campaigns with customer needs and feedback.
* Collect and provide valuable customer feedback to drive product and service improvements.
* Ensure compliance with the companys Quality Management System and processes.
* Key Performance Indicators
  + New logos won (medium to large, multi-site accounts).
  + Order intake and new annual recurring revenue against target.
  + Qualified pipeline value and coverage against target.
  + Account growth / net revenue retention on owned accounts.
  + Balance of new-business and existing-account revenue.
  + Forecast accuracy and CRM discipline (HubSpot).

**COMPETENCIES & PERSONAL ATTRIBUTES**

  

* Strong technical sales and business development experience in complex, solution-based B2B sales
* Established credibility and network in temperature-controlled, high-value supply chains; e.g. packaging, condition monitoring, specialty transport or life-science logistics
* Consultative, multi-stakeholder selling capability; comfortable engaging from operational level to C-suite
* Hunter mindset, with the discipline to develop and grow accounts over the long term
* Working understanding of GDP / GMP and customer validation / qualification requirements
* Proactive with excellent communication and negotiation skills
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple tasks
* Client-focused with the ability to understand customer needs
* Self-motivated, goal-oriented, and adaptable

**QUALIFICATIONS AND EDUCATION REQUIREMENTS**

  

* Master's or Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Life Sciences or Economics, or equivalent professional experience
* Typically 8+ years in B2B technic

**Responsibilities**

In this role, you’ll:

* Use your strong technical and diplomatic skills to address customer issues and provide customer feedback to Twilio’s Product and Engineering teams.
* Work with our customers' and partners' developers, architects, and support personnel to resolve complex problems with potentially very costly and far-reaching consequences.
* Collaborate with your teammates and the Twilio Product and Engineering teams via Slack as well as filing JIRAs to report reproducible bugs.
* Understanding customer trends, analyzing patterns, driving betterments and reporting what you observe to the management team in order to better improve our support process is a key part of the role.

**Qualifications**

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

* **Required:**

* 6 to 10+ years of relevant experience
* Good knowledge of RESTful technology, previous work with APIs and ability to understand and troubleshoot issues with cloud solutions.
* Broad capabilities to troubleshoot server-side code (Java, Node.js, PHP, C#, Python) and client-side JavaScript, with a good understanding of React and Redux
* Skilled in troubleshooting network connectivity issues, with an understanding of TCP/UDP, and basics of SSL/TLS.
* High competency in communicating complex technical issues to both technical and non-technical audiences via phone or email mediums
* Comfortable in working with customers’ developers to troubleshoot use of the Twilio helper libraries.
* Have an inquisitive mind to understand how things work
* Advanced time management skills, ability to work well under pressure, and proficiency at developing workflows to increase troubleshooting efficiency while still following standard processes and procedures.
* Excellence in task prioritization and evaluation of situational urgency.
* Interest in utilizing customer feedback to identify and drive improvements in our products.
* Enthusiasm for interacting and collaborating with other departments within Twilio in your search for the solutions our customers need.
* Ability to stand in the customer’s shoes and demonstrated dedication to the customer experience.
* Experience in managing dedicated customer accounts.

**Desired:**

* Understanding of Telecoms and VOIP including WebRTC and SIP

**Location**

This role will be remote,but is not eligible to be hired in CA, CT, NJ, NY, PA, WA.

**Travel**

We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, you may be required to travel occasionally to participate in project or team in-person meetings.

**What We Offer**

Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.

**Compensation**

The estimated pay ranges for this role are as follows:

* Based in Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maryland, Massachusetts, Minnesota, Vermont or Washington D.C. : $98,800 - $123,500
* Based in New York, New Jersey, Washington State, or California (outside of the San Francisco Bay area): $104,640 - $130,800
* Based in the San Francisco Bay area, California: $116,240 - $145,300
* This role may be eligible to participate in Twilio’s equity plan and corporate bonus plan. All roles are generally eligible for the following benefits: health care insurance, 401(k) retirement account, paid sick time, paid personal time off, paid parental leave.

The successful candidate’s starting salary will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience

jobs.title: Business Account Manager
jobs.description:
Business Account Manager, Wayfair Professional
  
  
The base salary range for this role is $37,000-$39,900, depending on location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience, with on-target earnings of $95,000-$110,000 (base + commission) and additional upside for overperformance.
  
  
**Location:** This position is fully remote within the U.S., with approximately 10% travel for trade shows and training.
  
  
About Wayfair Professional
  
  
Wayfair Professional is a leading B2B sales organization focused on helping businesses create exceptional, functional spaces. Since 2012, we've streamlined the procurement process for furniture, fixtures, and décor—delivering fast, reliable, and value-driven solutions tailored to the needs of commercial customers.
  
  
As a Business Account Manager (BAM), you’ll own a portfolio of B2B customers within a dedicated industry vertical (for example, Office, Property Management, Construction, Interior Design, or Accommodations) and act as their primary partner for furniture, fixtures, and décor.
  
  
This is a full-cycle sales role where you’ll combine proactive outreach, data-driven pipeline management, and consultative selling to grow revenue and deepen long-term relationships.
  
  
You’ll collaborate closely with Design, Service, and Large Project Solutions to deliver tailored, end-to-end solutions on complex projects—giving you a clear, differentiated value proposition and plenty of opportunity to win and grow accounts.
  
  
What You’ll Do
  
  
\*
  
  
Own and grow a portfolio of B2B accounts in your assigned vertical. Understand each account’s tier, purchasing cycle, decision-makers, potential spend, open opportunities, risks, and next growth action while balancing new, active, and dormant customers.
  
\*
  
  
Meet or exceed quarterly and annual revenue targets by protecting existing business, retaining customers, creating qualified new business, and expanding Furniture, Fixtures and Equipment (FF&E) share of wallet.
  
\*
  
  
Use personalized, value-led, phone-first outreach - including calls, emails, and virtual meetings in an effort to build relationships, establish two-way engagement, and uncover customer needs and opportunities.
  
\*
  
  
Lead consultative discovery to understand customer context, projects, FF&E needs, timing, decision-makers, decision path, and barriers; recommend relevant solutions across Wayfair Professional’s assortment, design support, project management, and other capabilities.
  
\*
  
  
Create opportunities for customer-confirmed needs or projects with a clear timeframe and agreed next step, then drive the sales process end to end - including advancing customer actions, removing blockers, asking for the order, and documenting accurate outcomes.
  
\*
  
  
Keep account strategies, customer insight, opportunities, and tasks current in Salesforce, with a relevant future action for each managed account and active opportunity. Use Salesforce, Looker, and Gong to prioritize work, maintain pipeline quality, and forecast accurately.
  
\*
  
  
Coordinate with Service, Design, Large Project Solutions, and other partners to deliver tailored solutions and clear handoffs. Take timely ownership of customer follow-up, resolve issues with a solution-oriented mindset, and help ensure customers do not have to repeat information or reconstruct a request.
  
\*
  
  
Build expertise in Wayfair Professional’s offerings and your industry vertical, using that knowledge to advise customers, communicate our value, and represent Wayfair with professionalism and integrity.
  
  
What You’ll Need
  
  
\*
  
  
3+ years of outbound sales experience and a strong record of achieving or exceeding sales KPIs and revenue targets.
  
\*
  
  
Experience managing a book of business is preferred. Relevant experience owning customer follow-up, qualified handoffs, or opportunities and pipeline in an outbound or pipeline-generating role is also valuable; B2B sales experience is strongly preferred.
  
\*
  
  
Demonstrated understanding of the sales process, pipeline management, customer qualification, and business buying cycles.
  
\*
  
  
Comfort in a fast-paced, high-growth environment; you take ownership of your performance and adapt as priorities and goals evolve.
  
\*
  
  
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to build rapport and influence customer decision-makers and internal partners.
  
\*
  
  
Strong proficiency with CRM systems (such as Salesforce), and virtual collaboration tools; experience with AI tools is a plus.
  
\*
  
  
Ability to work fully remotely within the U.S. and willingness to travel approximately 10% for trade shows and training.

jobs.title: Data Enablement Specialist
jobs.description:
How many people can answer the question, "What do you do for a living?" with the answer, "I help find cures for cancer." At Blood Cancer United, employees take our mission seriously. Whether you work in one of our regions, are an accountant at the national office or a specialist in our Information Resource Center, you work each day on making our bold goal a reality: to enable patients with blood cancer to gain more than one million years of life by 2040. Join us and give new meaning to the word, "job."
  
  
**Summary:** The Data Enablement Specialist ensures the organization’s data is accurate, accessible, and actionable across systems. This position supports enterprise data governance and quality by cataloging data assets, documenting metadata and business definitions, and monitoring data integrity using DAMA Data Management Principles. The role enables cross-functional teams to confidently use and understand organizational data, reducing reporting discrepancies and improving decision-making. By maintaining trusted data foundations, the position drives efficiency, transparency, and evidence-based insights across Blood Cancer United
  
  
**Duties and Responsibilities:**  

* Oversee and maintain data quality and enablement across systems by validating data accuracy, defining standards, and ensuring consistent data usage organization-wide.
* Administor and manage the enterprise data catalog, including metadata documentation, data ownership, and glossary definitions, and training to improve accessibility and understanding of structured enterprise data .
* Implement and monitor data quality checks and dashboards across key business areas to proactively identify and resolve data integrity issues.
* Partner with business and technical teams to raise data literacy, embed data governance policies into day-to-day work, and expand the use of structured, trusted data in decision-making.
* Support data access governance by coordinating and ensuring compliance with organizational and regulatory standards.
* Assist in the continuous improvement of data infrastructure, contributing to analytics readiness, automation, and AI enablement initiatives

#LI-Remote
  
  
**Education, Skills, and Experience:**  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Management Information Systems, or equivalent
* 2-5 years experience
* Data Governance, Quality, and Cataloging: Strong understanding of data governance frameworks, metadata management, and business glossary creation with hands-on experience using tools such as Secoda, Collibra, Ataccama, and Data.World to document data assets, define standards, and monitor data quality across systems.
* Knowledge of DAMA Principles and the DAMA data management lifecycle
* Data Privacy, Compliance, and Access Control: Working knowledge of HIPAA, GDPR, and CCPA regulations, with experience managing secure data access, permissions, and audit processes through platforms like Snowflake, Salesforce, and governance-enabled catalogs.
* Analytics, Reporting, and Enablement: Proficiency in SQL and visualization tools such as Tableau or Power BI for validating, profiling, and communicating data quality metrics; ability to translate technical insights into clear guidance that improves data literacy, governance adoption, and cross-functional data use.

As a valued member of Blood Cancer United, you are eligible for a comprehensive benefits package. The offered compensation may vary based on factors such as geographic location, business need, market conditions, proficiencies, skills, education, and experience. Additionally, at Blood Cancer United we place a high value on internal pay equity and will consider the current compensation of similarly situated roles and direct team members. Base compensation is only one component of our Total Rewards program, which also includes an annual incentive plan and a competitive benefits package.

jobs.title: Customer Enablement Trainer

-----------------------

Latent is the enterprise pharmacy intelligence platform, powered by a clinical agentic engine, that enables health systems to grow their pharmacy operations and serve more patients. One engine works across the pharmacy journey to identify patients who qualify for care, improve medication access, capture eligible prescriptions and support patients throughout treatment.

Latent’s platform enables more than 60+ leading health systems that collectively serve an estimated 70 million people. Founded by Sri Somasundaram and Rishabh Jain, Latent has raised $80 million from Transformation Capital, Spark Capital, Conviction, General Catalyst, Y Combinator, and others.

**About the Role**
------------------

As a **Customer Enablement Trainer**, you’ll play a critical role in activating customers and accelerating time-to-value. You’ll design and deliver impactful training experiences that translate Latent’s AI-powered platform into intuitive, real-world clinical and operational workflows.

You’ll work directly with clinicians, pharmacists, operational leaders, and IT teams — helping them confidently adopt Latent and drive measurable outcomes. This role sits at the intersection of product, implementation, and customer success, partnering closely with Implementation, Account Management, Sales/Partnerships, Product, and Clinical teams.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

### **Training Delivery & Facilitation**

* Lead live virtual and onsite training sessions across clinical and operational user groups
* Deliver role-based enablement that drives proficiency and reinforces best practices
* Facilitate hands-on product walkthroughs, Q&A sessions, and office hours
* Own go-live training execution to ensure customer readiness and successful launches

### **Curriculum & Content Development**

* Create engaging training materials including decks, quick-start guides, videos, e-learning modules, and workflow job aids
* Customize training based on clinical workflows, customer use cases, and user roles
* Partner with Product and Product Marketing to keep training content aligned with product releases

### **Customer Readiness & Adoption**

* Serve as a product expert across Latent’s features, workflows, and applied use cases
* Assess customer training needs and recommend the right mix of live and asynchronous learning
* Collect feedback and iterate on training programs to continuously improve quality and impact
* Support adoption goals by reinforcing key behaviors and success metrics post-implementation

### **Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Partner with Implementation and Account Management to align training with customer goals
* Share frontline insights to inform product improvements and enablement strategy
* Collaborate with Clinical and Technical teams to ensure training is accurate, compliant, and healthcare-grade

**What You Bring**
------------------

### **Experience**

* 3–6+ years in customer enablement, training, or education within SaaS, healthcare technology, digital health, or clinical operations
* Experience training clinicians or healthcare operational users strongly preferred
* Background in implementation, customer success, or clinical education is a plus

### **Skills**

* Exceptional facilitator who can engage audiences with clarity, confidence, and empathy
* Strong instructional design and curriculum development capabilities
* Ability to simplify complex AI-driven workflows into intuitive experiences
* Excellent communication and storytelling skills
* Comfortable operating in a fast-paced startup environment

### **Mindset**

* Deeply customer-centric with a passion for helping others succeed
* Ownership-driven with a bias toward action
* Thrive in ambiguity and adapt quickly
* Motivated by improving healthcare at scale

**Why Latent Health**
---------------------

* Mission-driven team tackling one of healthcare’s biggest challenges
* High-ownership culture with meaningful growth opportunities
* Competitive compensation, equity, and benefits
* Work alongside leading experts in AI, healthcare, and product innovation

This role is responsible for managing assigned accounts, developing customer relationships, and identifying opportunities to grow revenue within designated accounts and territories.

* Demonstrated ability to build customer relationships, identify growth opportunities, and achieve sales objectives.
* Experience managing customer accounts and developing business plans is preferred.

**PREFERRED EDUCATION**

Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Life Sciences, or a related field preferred.

**KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS & COMPETENCIES**

* Strong communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to develop and maintain professional customer relationships across multiple organizational levels.
* Self-motivated with the ability to take ownership of assigned accounts and priorities while seeking guidance on more complex opportunities.
* Strong organizational, planning, and time management skills.

jobs.title: Payer Strategy & Operations
jobs.description:
**Location**
------------

Remote in the USA

**Employment Type**
-------------------

Full time

**Location Type**
-----------------

Remote

**Department**
--------------

Strategy & Operations

  

**We're building a new healthcare clearinghouse**
=================================================

Stedi is the only headless clearinghouse and RCM engine. Headless means every part of our product is accessible via API. Developers and AI agents build their own interface on top of it. By offering modern, AI-ready APIs alongside traditional real-time and batch EDI processes, we enable both healthcare technology businesses and established players to exchange mission-critical transactions. Our clearinghouse product and customer-first approach have set us apart. Stedi was ranked by Ramp as one of the fastest-growing SaaS vendors.

Stedi has lightning in a bottle: engineers and designers shipping products week in and week out; a lean business team supporting the company's infrastructure; a passion for automation and eliminating toil; and $142 million in funding from top investors like Stripe, Addition, USV, Bloomberg Beta, First Round Capital, and more.

To see what we ship, watch the 2026 Stedi Keynote. To learn more about how we work, watch our founder Zack's interview with First Round Capital.

**What we are looking for**
---------------------------

Stedi is an API-first healthcare clearinghouse. By offering a modern API interface for running eligibility checks, processing claims, and ingesting ERAs, healthcare technology businesses are able to exchange transactions with payers without dealing with the EDI protocol or carrier-specific connectivity.

We are growing our Payer Strategy & Operations team. This team serves as “air traffic control” for the millions of eligibility checks, claims, remittances, and claim status messages that flow between providers and virtually every payer across the country. In this role, you will work directly with payers, other clearinghouses, customers, and internal operations teams to ensure we can offer the most reliable and cost effective routes to payers across all transaction sets and protocols.

The work moves fast, spans a lot of surface area, and has real impact - both on our payers, customers, costs, and our roadmap.

**Who you are**
---------------

* **You have ample experience integrating with APIs, building tools, and working with data:** you are familiar with REST/SOAP APIs and have hands-on experience building integrations to backend systems and applications. You have experience building internal tools, running queries, and manipulating data to move faster.
* **You are exceptional at staying on top of many open threads simultaneously.** You are hyper-responsive, organized, and thorough. You almost never drop balls.
* **You have experience in externally facing roles:** You have experience in client-facing roles; ideally within consulting, technical support, implementation and onboarding, or solutions engineering roles.
* **You have a systems mindset.** You go beyond helping with the task at hand. You are able to intuitively understand gaps as you work through implementations and are able to articulate those to the product, payer operations, and engineering team.
* **You do what it takes to get the job done.** You are resourceful, self-motivating, self-disciplined, and don’t wait to be told what to do. You put in the hours.
* **You move quickly**. We move quickly as an organization. This requires an ability to match our pace and not get lost by responding with urgency (both externally to payers and internally to stakeholders), communicating what you are working on, and proactively asking for help or feedback when you need it.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Analyze data to make high velocity decisions on how and where to route traffic
* Build internal tooling to streamline payer onboarding, payer routing and mapping, and data synchronization across internal applications
* Handle payer and clearinghouse-related incidents, from escalating directly to payers to sounding internal alarms and diving into root causes
* Collaborate with product and engineering to advance our roadmap for internal applications, as well as external payer-related products and APIs

*The annual compensation range for this role is $120,000-$200,000. For roles with a variable component, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, which means that the range is inclusive of the sales commissions or bonus target and annual base salary. This range may be inclusive of multiple experience levels at Stedi and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, location, and qualifications. Please reach out to your recruiter with any questions.*

**We’ve been made aware of individuals impersonating the Stedi recruiting team.** Please note:

* All official communication about roles at Stedi will **only come from an @****stedi.com** **email address**, or from our official identification verification partner, Persona, @frompersona.com.
* If you’re unsure whether a message is legitimate or have any concerns, feel free to **contact us directly at** **careers@stedi.com****.**

We appreciate your attention to this and your interest in joining Stedi.

*At Stedi, we're looking for people who are deeply curious and aligned to our ways of working. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't perfectly match the job description.*

jobs.title: Revenue Operations Analyst
jobs.description:
**Location**
------------

Remote - United States & Canada

**Employment Type**
-------------------

Full time

**Location Type**
-----------------

Remote

**Department**
--------------

Revenue

  

Small businesses represent 99.9% of all companies, yet they're still forced to choose between clunky, outdated enterprise phone systems or their personal phones. This multi-billion dollar market has been overlooked for decades, left to cobble together solutions that slow them down instead of helping them grow.

  

Quo is changing that. We bring calls, texts, and customer information together into one easy-to-use, AI-powered platform. We're not just building a phone system. We're setting a new standard for how businesses connect with their customers.

  

Driven by our values, we move fast, build with determination, and obsess over delivering value to the businesses that have been underserved for far too long.

  

Today, Quo is trusted by more than 120,000 companies and rated #1 in customer satisfaction on G2. We're backed by Y Combinator, Tiger Global, Craft Ventures, Slow Ventures, and other top-tier investors. It's safe to say we're onto something big.

**About the role**
==================

We're looking for a Revenue Operations Analyst to be the operational backbone of our revenue org: the person who keeps our revenue systems and data trustworthy, so our New Business, Franchise, Customer Success, and Partnerships teams can run on numbers they believe.

You’ll work directly with leaders across every revenue function, learn the full stack from Salesforce to our AI-powered workflows, and join a small team where your work is visible. You’ll start close to the day-to-day requests, because that’s the fastest way to learn our systems and our teams. Over your first few months, you’ll move from handling requests to fixing what causes them, with about a third of your time going to improvement projects once you’re ramped.

This is a hands-on IC role reporting to the Director of Revenue Operations and working closely with the Sr. Revenue Operations Manager.

**Some of the things you’ll do:**
---------------------------------

* Keep dashboards and Salesforce reports accurate as the revenue teams’ needs evolve, partnering with our Data team, and support ad hoc analysis for revenue leadership
* Monitor data quality (completeness, duplicates, stale records), fix issues at the source, and own specific targets such as account matching and activity tracking
* Validate key metrics before they reach dashboards or alerts. As we add more automated signals for our revenue teams, track whether they lead to action and work with the team to refine them
* Monitor our automated and AI-powered workflows, diagnose failures, and handle light maintenance
* Be the go-to partner for our revenue teams on Salesforce, dashboards, and other revenue tools
* Diagnose and fix broken syncs, report errors, and data discrepancies, tracing them to the root cause so they don’t repeat
* Manage intake for revenue team requests: prioritize, resolve routine asks end to end, escalate urgent or complex ones, and close the loop
* Manage our operating knowledge base: keep the data dictionary, runbooks, and FAQs accurate as systems change, and use request trends to cut repeat questions
* Handle day-to-day administration of the revenue tech stack, and test Salesforce changes after they ship
* Support routing, onboarding handoff, and renewal processes, and flag breakdowns so they get fixed at the source
* Support quota, territory, and forecasting cycles with data pulls and reconciliation

**About you**
=============

* 1-3 years in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or a related role, ideally at a SaaS or high-growth tech company
* Comfortable working in Salesforce day to day: reports, dashboards, and basic flow and automation troubleshooting
* Working SQL proficiency and experience with a BI tool (Mode, Omni, or similar) for pulling and checking data
* Detail-oriented: you catch a broken sync or a duplicate record before it becomes a bad decision
* Strong communicator: you can explain a data issue to a rep or an exec without jargon
* Comfortable being a go-to partner for the revenue team: prioritizing competing asks and following through until they’re resolved
* Comfortable using AI tools (Claude, Gumloop, or similar) to automate your own repetitive work

**Nice to have**
----------------

* Experience at a PLG or product-led company
* Experience in a customer-facing or quota-bearing role (BDR, SDR, CSM, etc.)
* Salesforce Administrator certification or hands-on admin experience
* Familiarity with tools in our stack: Gong, Outreach, Default, Unify, PartnerStack, SmartLead, Snowflake, or Fivetran

**Compensation**
================

The annual base salary range for this position is as follow, plus equity and benefits:

* SF Bay Area, Los Angeles, Seattle, Portland, Boston, New York, and Washington, DC Metro: $108,000 - $127,000 USD
* All other US Locations: $97,000 - $114,000 USD
* Canada: $99,000 - $115,000 CAD

The ranges displayed reflect the target for new hire salaries, and within each range, individual pay is determined by your skills and experience, as well as relevant education. Your recruiter can share more and answer questions about the specific salary range during the hiring process.

Salary is just one component of Quo’s total compensation package. Your total rewards package will include equity, extensive medical coverage, a monthly lifestyle stipend, and a flexible PTO policy.

**Who we are**
==============

  

We're a remote-first company with a culture of trust, autonomy, and action. As we rapidly grow, we're intentionally building communities in a handful of hub cities while continuing to hire great talent wherever they happen to live. If you're looking for a place to do your best work, we'd love to hear from you.

  

And remember, there's no such thing as a 'perfect' candidate. We're looking for optimists with grit and

new_jobs.description:
**About us**
============

Parallel is a web infrastructure company. Our products are used by leading businesses in sales, marketing, insurance, and coding to build best-in-class AI agents with flexible and powerful programmatic access to the web.

We've raised $230 million from Kleiner Perkins, Sequoia, Index Ventures, Spark Capital, Khosla Ventures, First Round, and Terrain to build the web for AIs. We're currently valued at $2 billion and we're forming a world-class team of engineers, designers, marketers, sellers, researchers, and operational experts to achieve our mission.

**Job:** Parallel’s GTM team is growing rapidly, and we need to scale our onboarding and enablement programs to keep pace. You’ll own onboarding and core enablement programs across the full new hire journey for AEs, Deployed Engineers, Partner AEs, and GTM Recruiting. You’ll run onboarding end to end, owning both content and logistics, from the pre-work new hires complete before bootcamp (industry context, product fundamentals, and our sales process through video, assessments, and AI roleplays) to our monthly live bootcamps. You’ll build out and manage our LMS/CMS and AI roleplay tools to create clear learning paths and self-serve resources, and build a follow-on program for reps a few months into the role focused on live deal execution, deal reviews, and call reviews. You’ll lead live sessions, keep training focused on what matters most to sellers, and use feedback from each cohort to improve the next. You’ll use AI, automation, and tooling to keep programs running smoothly as we grow, and partner on planning and programming for QBRs, Sales Kickoffs, and other large-scale GTM events.  
  
**You:** You have direct sales experience (e.g., SDR, AE) and strong instincts for what makes GTM teams effective. You’ve owned onboarding or enablement programs, ideally including live training, and experience managing an LMS/CMS is a plus. You have 2-3+ years in tech, ideally at a fast-paced startup. You’re highly organized with strong project management skills and can manage multiple programs at once. You’re an excellent communicator and confident facilitator, you use AI tools naturally in your work to make programs more efficient, and you enjoy building from the ground up in a fast-moving environment.

**Life at Parallel**
====================

We believe in a fully in person work culture 5 days a week. We’re building strong offices in San Francisco, Palo Alto, Austin, and New York. Your office and in office days will depend on your team, and we will walk you through the details during the interview process. We’re a flat, talent-dense organization dedicated to solving technical and creative problems.

We seek like-minded individuals who share our passion for applying science, creativity, and consistency to big and complex problems with equally big outcomes. These are our values:

* **Own customer impact:** It’s on us to ensure real-world outcomes for our customers.
* **Obsess over craft:** Perfect every detail because quality compounds.
* **Accelerate change**: Ship fast, adapt faster, and move frontier ideas into production.
* **Create win-wins**: Creatively turn trade-offs into upside.
* **Make high-conviction bets**: Try and fail. But succeed an unfair amount.

**Compensation & benefits**
===========================

* Competitive salary
* Generous equity
* Visa sponsorships
* 401K plans
* Daily lunch & office snacks
* Dinner at the office
* Unlimited vacation
* Caltrain pass reimbursement

Compensation Range: $140K - $200K

**Purpose**

As an **Account Manager – North & South Carolina**, you will be responsible for driving sales growth and expanding BVI’s presence across the assigned territory. You will develop and maintain strong relationships with ophthalmic surgeons, clinical teams, and healthcare organizations while identifying opportunities to introduce and expand BVI’s portfolio. The role combines strategic territory management, consultative selling, clinical product support, and new business development across hospitals, ASCs, and private practice settings.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop and execute a territory strategy to achieve and exceed assigned sales targets across North and South Carolina.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with ophthalmic surgeons, clinical staff, purchasing teams, and other key decision-makers.
* Identify, prospect, and develop new business opportunities while expanding BVI’s presence within existing accounts.
* Promote BVI’s ophthalmic portfolio by communicating the clinical and commercial value of products to customers and end users.
* Provide product demonstrations and clinical support within customer facilities, including operating room environments where appropriate.
* Analyze territory performance, customer activity, sales data, and competitive intelligence to prioritize opportunities and guide account strategy.
* Use CRM and other sales tools to effectively plan customer interactions, document activities, track opportunities, and maintain accurate account information.
* Partner with Marketing, Clinical Affairs, Customer Service, Operations, and other BVI teams to deliver an effective customer experience and identify opportunities to expand the BVI portfolio.

  

**Qualification**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Healthcare, Life Sciences, or a related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Minimum of 3 years of successful sales experience within healthcare, medical devices, pharmaceuticals, or a related industry.
* Experience selling to healthcare professionals, hospitals, ASCs, physician practices, or other healthcare organizations.
* Ophthalmology experience is strongly preferred, particularly experience working with surgical products or technologies.
* Demonstrated success in developing new business while growing and retaining existing customer accounts.
* Strong consultative selling, communication, and presentation skills, with the ability to engage effectively with surgeons, clinical staff, and business stakeholders.
* Ability to analyze sales data, manage territory priorities, and use CRM and other sales tools to drive effective account strategies.
* Willingness and ability to travel regularly throughout North & South Carolina, including occasional overnight travel, and to work in clinical and operating-room environments as required.

  

**Company**

BVI® is refocusing the future of vision.
  
  
As one of the fastest-growing, diversified surgical ophthalmic businesses in the world, our purpose-built portfolio of trusted brands includes: Beaver® (Knives and Blades), Visitec® (Cannulas), Malosa® (Single-Use Instruments), Vitreq® (Vitreoretinal Surgical Products) and PhysIOL® (Premium IOLs), and spans more than 90 countries.
  
  
We’ve set our sights on touching the lives of millions of patients affected by conditions such as cataracts, refractive error, glaucoma, retinal disease, and dry eye. Unburdened by legacy or bureaucracy, we have developed our strategy around a simple concept – taking pride in delivering innovative solutions for our physicians and patients, based on their needs. We trust and empower our associates to make decisions and solve problems because collaboration drives us. Valuing agility, simplicity, and transparency, we stay committed to listening to our customers, delivering for our patients, and keeping the future in focus.
  
  
Learn more at www.bvimedical.com
